jobs.title: Database Development for Lead Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
Overview 
We are building a specialized lead intelligence platform that helps businesses identify high-value prospects in a niche market. The platform consists of a front-end application (already under development) and a secure back-end that will house the database, process data, and deliver results via API. 

Your task is to design and build the database architecture, implement a data pipeline, and develop a secure scoring engine that assigns a priority score to each record based on proprietary criteria. 

Objectives 

Develop a scalable, AWS-hosted database (or similar cloud solution) to store company data and lead attributes. 

Create a data ingestion pipeline to pull information from multiple sources (APIs, external lists, and other connectors). 

Implement a data cleaning and categorization process to standardize incoming data. 

Build a secure scoring mechanism that applies weighted logic (provided separately) to rank and prioritize leads. 

Expose API endpoints so the front-end application can interact with the database without exposing proprietary logic. 

 

Scope of Work 

Database Architecture 

Design schema to store company profiles, attributes, and computed scores. 

Ensure scalability and efficient querying for future growth. 

Prepare for periodic updates and enrichment of records. 

Data Pipeline Development 

Set up connectors to fetch data from approved sources. 

Implement cleaning and categorization workflows. 

Ensure incoming data is normalized before entering the database. 

Scoring Engine 

Collaborate with our team to implement a proprietary scoring algorithm. 

The algorithm will be encapsulated and protected to prevent exposure of underlying logic. 

Output a composite score and lead classification (e.g., hot/warm/cold). 

API Development 

Build secure endpoints for the front-end to query and filter leads. 

Ensure the API does not reveal proprietary data-processing methods. 

Security & IP Protection 

Apply access controls and encryption as needed. 

Ensure the scoring logic and data sources remain confidential and protected from third-party access. 

Deliverables 

Architecture documentation 

Database schema and deployment 

Data pipeline scripts/services 

Scoring engine (securely encapsulated) 

API endpoints with documentation 

 Bonus Points: Add HEALTHY PLANET to proposal :)

Requirements 

Experience with AWS (preferred) or other cloud-hosted database solutions 

Strong background in ETL pipelines, data processing, and API development 

Ability to build secure, scalable backend solutions 

Familiarity with protecting proprietary logic in cloud environments 

Engagement Model 

Initial Phase: Delivery of database architecture and data pipeline for MVP. 

Subsequent Phases: Iterative enhancements and feature expansion. 

Ownership: All code, schemas, and documentation developed under this contract remain the exclusive property of our company.

jobs.title: RAG Expert for HIPAA Compliant Conversational AI - No agencies please
jobs.description:
We are building a closed, HIPAA-compliant Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system powered by thousands of real-world conversations and a private knowledge base. The system will run entirely within our secure AWS infrastructure—no third-party APIs or external inference endpoints will be used. It will be built using a Python Flask server and the Pydantic AI framework (https://ai.pydantic.dev/). We’re seeking an experienced ML engineer to lead this project from architecture through secure deployment.


Phase 1 – Model Selection, Message Review & System Architecture

- Review a sample of internal conversation data to assess structure, tone, and complexity
- Evaluate open-source LLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Mixtral, Falcon) for fit within a closed, local RAG architecture
- Select the most appropriate model based on privacy, performance, and licensing constraints
- Define the full architecture including retriever, embedding model, vector store (e.g., pgvector or FAISS), and local inference setup
- Design the backend API using Flask and structure it using the Pydantic AI framework
- Ensure HIPAA-compliant design across infrastructure, data flow, and access control

Phase 2 – Data Preparation & AWS Infrastructure

- Apply PHI redaction/pseudonymization to all proprietary content
- Prepare content for embedding and retrieval (e.g., chunking, metadata tagging)
- Deploy fully private AWS infrastructure: EC2 or ECS, VPC, encrypted S3, IAM, and KMS
- Build and populate a secure, query-optimized vector database

Phase 3 – RAG Pipeline Integration & Backend Development

- Integrate embedding, retrieval, and generation components into a working RAG pipeline
- Build Flask server endpoints and structure logic using Pydantic AI components
- Implement logging, error handling, and basic tracing

Phase 4 – Deployment, Security, and Handoff

- Deploy a fully self-contained RAG system within AWS
- Set up endpoint authentication, HTTPS, access controls, and audit logging
- Configure CloudWatch, GuardDuty, and related observability tools
- Deliver comprehensive documentation and operational handoff materials

 
Deliverables

[ ] Model selection report with justification and benchmarking plan
[ ] RAG system architecture diagram and technical spec
[ ] Secure AWS infrastructure (Terraform or deployment scripts if applicable)
[ ] Working RAG pipeline with local inference, retriever, and vector DB
[ ] Flask + Pydantic AI backend exposing a secure, modular API
[ ] Logging and monitoring configuration for inference and retrieval
[ ] HIPAA-compliant deployment with full encryption, role-based access, and audit logging
[ ] Final system documentation, setup instructions, and codebase walkthrough

What We’re Looking For

- Demonstrated experience deploying closed, self-hosted RAG systems using proprietary data
- Strong ability to review real-world message data and apply insights to system design
- Hands-on expertise with Flask, Python, and the Pydantic AI framework
- Proficiency with AWS architecture and HIPAA compliance standards
- Strong understanding of open-source LLMs, embeddings, and vector search
- Direct contributor only – no subcontractors or outsourced work
- Must be willing to sign a BAA
- Must be willing to undergo Background Check
- No agencies please

jobs.title: Multi‑Phase Computer Vision Pipeline (Open‑Source Models)
jobs.description:
We are building a proof of concept for a CCTV analytics pipeline using completely open‑source computer vision models. The system will ultimately ingest RTSP streams from CCTV cameras (accessed via IP and port) but, for the proof of concept, it will run on a local machine using prepared video clips. The processed data will be stored in a MongoDB database, and the database format and schema will be provided.

The first phase focuses on people counting and the classification of gender and age groups. The second phase will extend the pipeline to store face embeddings to detect returning faces (without any personal identification) and perform sentiment analysis using facial expression detection (e.g. happy, neutral, angry). For example, the system should be able to report that 50% of the faces seen today were seen previously or that 20% of faces are frequent visitors. The final phase will involve tracking individuals across multiple cameras to generate heatmaps of visitor routes through a monitored area.

We are looking for someone who has extensive experience with open‑source computer vision models such as YOLO, DeepFace, InsightFace, FER+, Detectron2 or similar, and who can integrate these into a modular pipeline. Experience working with RTSP streams, FFmpeg, message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka, and MongoDB is essential. The deliverable for this proof of concept is a working pipeline that pulls prepared clips (to simulate RTSP feeds), processes the frames and stores analytics such as counts, demographics, embeddings and sentiment data into MongoDB.

This is a multi‑phase project, and we expect to continue working with the same person for later phases if the proof of concept is successful.

Since we're looking for just a proof of concept, we want to build something in no more than 2 weeks.

You must be able to work between 9.00am and 6.00pm GMT+3 timezone, FLUENT in English, able to join me on a video call to discuss the project further, and demonstrate previous work.

Thanks.

jobs.title: Stripe middleware
jobs.description:
Job: Stripe Checkout Integration with Joomla & PayPlans (Joomla component)

We're building a subscription onboarding flow using Stripe Checkout, integrated into a custom Joomla 3.x component (com_stripeconnect) that currently only takes care of generating a Stripe checkout through an API request for the purpose of extending existing subscriptions. You’ll be working in Stripe test mode with access to our dev server.

Scope:
- Create a frontend form to collect email, company name, and VAT ID
- Validate VAT ID (via VIES if possible)
- Check if the email exists in Joomla – if it does, offer login; otherwise redirect to Stripe Checkout
- Configure Stripe Checkout with initial price (e.g. €1,999) and lower recurring price (e.g. €1,111/year). The Stripe product will be configured accordingly. 
- Enable VAT collection and promotion code field in Checkout
- Handle Stripe webhook (invoice.paid or checkout.session.completed)
- On webhook, create Joomla user if they don’t exist
- Create PayPlans subscription in the database based on price_id mapping
- Store Stripe customer_id for later use
- Show a Stripe Customer Portal link in the user’s PayPlans account view

Requirements:
- Strong experience with PHP and Joomla development
- Familiarity with Stripe API (Checkout, Webhooks, Customer Portal)
- Understanding of PayPlans database structure not necessary
- Ability to deliver a clean MVP without unnecessary dependencies

The reason for this work is that the Payplans component is not reliable and is misfiring recurring payments. Since we want to keep it for subscription management, we need a custom solution. Fluent English level necessary.
jobs.ai_remark: Recommend UI/UX services for designing user-friendly frontend form, VAT ID validation, and seamless Stripe Checkout integration with Joomla component for subscription onboarding flow.

Item code → Internal reference.
Product image (~2 cm height).
Product name.
Footer: company information.

- Compatible with Odoo v18 and designed to work with future versions.

- Complete development and integration into our Odoo Online -environment.
- Clear entry point to launch PDF generation (e.g., button).
- Final PDF meeting the requested specifications.
- Short user guide for autonomous use.

- Experience with SaaS environment constraints (no backend access).

**Remote | Freelance | Part-time (3–4 days/week)**

We’re a small team building a secure AI platform for businesses that care about data privacy, transparency, and performance. Our focus is on real-time integrations, GDPR compliance, and full control over sensitive data—without compromising on UX or model performance.

We’re looking for a freelance developer who wants to work hands-on, shape technical decisions, and grow with us as we bring this platform to life. If you enjoy building meaningful features and value autonomy, ownership, and speed over corporate overhead—let’s talk.

- **Develop modern, AI-powered web applications** as part of the platform’s core development team
- **Build real-time features** such as chat interfaces, model switching, source tracking, and file upload functionality using cutting-edge LLM APIs
- **Work across the full stack**: from scalable backend APIs and authentication layers to responsive, component-based frontends
- **Contribute to architecture decisions** and help shape the developer experience from day one
- **Collaborate cross-functionally** with product, design, and leadership—bringing technical feasibility into strategic conversations
- **(Optionally) Take ownership** of individual modules or customer-specific extensions

- Strong experience in modern web development using **TypeScript, Next.js, React**, and **Node.js**
- Confidence in working with **PostgreSQL** and tools like **Drizzle ORM**
- Solid understanding of **authentication and security best practices**, including **NextAuth.js**
- Familiarity with cloud-based services such as **Supabase**, **AWS S3**, or **Azure**

- You care about clean, maintainable code and enjoy working in **Git-based workflows**
- You value **ownership, initiative, and clear communication** in a distributed team environment
- **Bonus**: Basic German language skills or willingness to learn

### Our Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React Server Components, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: Node.js, Drizzle ORM, Vercel serverless functions
- **Database & Auth**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, NextAuth.js
- **AI Providers**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, Azure OpenAI
- **Infra**: Vercel, AWS S3, pnpm

### What We Offer

- Freelance contract with competitive day rates
- Remote-first team culture (100% remote, async-friendly)
- A young, distributed team that values autonomy, quality, and shared learning
- The opportunity to shape a new platform from the ground up

jobs.title: AI Audio Platform Developer Needed
jobs.description:
Description:

We’re building an innovative web-based tool that allows users to upload any sound (e.g., bassline, synth lead, pad), and our system will generate a patch/preset that can be imported directly into Xfer Serum 2 for further manipulation.

This is a complex, multi-stage project involving AI audio analysis, preset mapping, and web development. We’re looking for a talented AI & audio-savvy full-stack developer with deep understanding of Serum architecture, audio synthesis, and frontend/backend skills to bring this to life.

What the Platform Will Do:

User uploads an audio file (WAV/MP3).

Audio is analysed (pitch, waveform, filters, modulation etc).

AI/ML model converts this into Serum-compatible patch settings.

User can preview a playback via web audio (optional).

User downloads a .fxp or .vstpreset patch file.

Ideal Skills & Experience:

Experience with audio signal processing

Machine Learning for audio — experience with tools like autoencoders, Wav2Vec, NSynth, or Mel spectrogram-based models

Experience with synthesizer architecture, especially Xfer Serum, and knowledge of preset file structure (e.g., .fxp)

Strong backend experience (Python preferred; Flask/Django)

Strong frontend skills (React, Next.js preferred)

Comfortable working with Web Audio API or Tone.js for previews

Bonus: Familiarity with Max/MSP, PureData, or JUCE framework

Deliverables:

Functional web app (UI + backend)

Working model that converts audio → Serum patch

Downloadable .fxp or .vstpreset patch files

We would like someone who is interested in becoming apart of the team and working on this long term as we expand, we are partnered with some of the biggest musicians in the space and have access to millions of users, if we can create a working product we expect we will expand very fast. 

To Apply:
Please include:

Relevant experience with AI + audio/synthesis

Any experience with Serum or similar synthesizers

Examples of related tools you've built (audio plugins, ML tools, etc.)

Estimated timeline and preferred tech stack

jobs.title: ESP32-S3 - Speed Calculation Firmware Module with proximity
jobs.description:
LineGuard ESP32-S3 - Speed Calculation Module - Technical Documentation
1. Introduction
This document provides a detailed technical explanation of the LineGuard firmware developed for the ESP32-S3 board. It focuses on the module responsible for computing speed based on proximity sensor input, with particular emphasis on debounce logic, timeout handling, and unit conversion. The firmware includes a web server, SD logging, OTA updates, and configuration through NVS.
2. Speed Measurement Logic
2.1 Pulse Capture (input_processing.cpp)
A circular buffer (`pulseBuffer`) is used to record timestamps of valid falling edges detected on the configured speed sensor pin. The ISR responsible for this buffering filters out spurious signals using a fixed debounce window defined as:

 static const unsigned long DEBOUNCE_TIME_MICROS = 200000; // 200 ms

Each valid pulse updates the buffer and is processed later in the main loop to compute speed.
2.2 Speed Calculation
The time difference between two consecutive valid pulses is used to compute the speed:

 speed_mpm = (meters_per_pulse / time_diff_seconds) * 60

This value is stored in `currentSpeedMetersPerMinute` and updated at every valid pulse detection. `meters_per_pulse` is user-configurable and loaded from non-volatile storage (NVS) via Preferences.
2.3 Timeout Handling
If no new pulse is detected for a time exceeding `active_speed_timeout_ms`, the system assumes the roller is stationary and sets the speed to 0. This ensures that the speed value always reflects recent activity.
2.4 Configuration System (config.cpp)
All critical parameters, including debounce delay, meters per pulse, monitored pins, and static IP settings, are loaded from NVS using the Preferences library. These values can be adjusted through the web interface and persist across reboots.
2.5 Web Interface and Monitoring (web_server_pages.cpp)
The web server exposes a monitoring page displaying the current speed value (`currentSpeedMetersPerMinute`) and a log of timestamps corresponding to each pulse received. This aids in debugging and validating sensor behavior in real time.
3. Problems Observed
Despite the logic in place, tests on a slow machine show highly erratic speed readings. For example:

 - From 11.81 to 0 m/min in one second
 - From 0 to 8.39 m/min instantly
 - From 0 to 35.71 m/min while the max real-world speed is ~15 m/min
 - From 9.64 to 123.82 m/min, which is physically impossible

These variations indicate likely issues in ISR timing, debounce effectiveness, and possibly flawed assumptions in the pulse-to-speed conversion formula.
4. Proposed Fix & Collaboration
The objective is to stabilize speed readings and make the system reliable for industrial use. Any candidate interested in collaborating is invited to review the included project and propose fixes, ideally estimating hours and cost.

jobs.title: AI Exam Tutor MVP Development
jobs.description:
I’m looking for a skilled developer to build an AI-powered exam tutor MVP, focused initially on the professional certifications. This MVP is for personal use and limited testing before scaling to a full platform. The AI agent should act like a smart tutor: personalized, interactive, and able to learn from user behavior.

🎯 Goals of the MVP
	•	Create a simple but powerful web-based app where a user logs in, interacts with an AI tutor, and receives personalized guidance to study and pass an exam.

🧩 Key Features Required:
1. AI Tutor Agent (ChatGPT-powered or similar):
	•	Interacts with the user like a personal tutor
	•	Uses both its own knowledge and uploaded content (PDFs, notes, etc.)
	•	Answers questions, gives guidance, explains concepts
	•	Adapts to each user based on previous interactions

2. Memory / Personalization:
	•	Recognizes and remembers each user
	•	Stores and retrieves chat history, feedback, performance
	•	Learns from user input (e.g., “I didn’t understand that concept”)

👤 Core User Experience
	•	Users log in securely (Google OAuth or secure password-based login)
	•	They chat with the AI tutor, which remembers their previous sessions, feedback, and performance
	•	They can upload documents (PDFs or study notes), which the AI will use to answer questions or generate practice content
	•	They can test themselves via:
	•	Quiz Mode: question-by-question practice with instant feedback
	•	Mock Exam Mode: timed simulation with delayed feedback, full score report, and progress tracking

🔧 Technical Requirements for MVP
✅ AI-Powered Tutor Agent:
	•	Integrate GPT-4 (OpenAI) as core LLM
	•	Pull knowledge from uploaded study materials + GPT’s own understanding
	•	Retain memory per user:
	•	Tracks what the user asked, where they struggled, what feedback they gave
	•	Use vector database (like Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
	•	Structure prompts modularly or use role-specific behavior for different functions (e.g., tutoring, testing, feedback).

✅ Content Management:
	•	I must be able to upload new study content or questions myself without developer support
	•	PDF, Google docs/sheets, text, CSV formats
	•	Questions should include:
	•	Question
	•	A/B/C/D answers
	•	Correct answer
	•	Explanation
	•	Optional topic tag
	•	A basic admin panel or form to upload this is fine

✅ Quiz Mode:
	•	One question at a time
	•	Instant feedback and explanation
	•	Tracks results and stores them per user

✅ Mock Exam Mode:
	•	User selects number of questions (e.g., 50 or 100)
	•	One question shown at a time
	•	Timer simulates real exam
	•	No feedback during test
	•	After exam:
	•	Total score
	•	Answer review: user response, correct answer, explanation
	•	(Optional) Breakdown by topic
	•	Results feed into the AI memory to adjust tutoring strategy

🔒 Privacy Requirements
	•	Encrypt user data and store securely
	•	Users must be able to request deletion of their data
	•	Include simple privacy disclaimer:

“We store your exam results and chat history only to personalize your study experience. Your data will never be shared or sold.”

🎨 Design/UI
	•	Clean, minimalist frontend (you can use low-code or frameworks like Streamlit, React, or Next.js)
	•	Mobile responsiveness

💼 Future Scope (if MVP goes well)
	•	Add more certifications 
	•	Full course platform powered by AI tutors

⏱️ Timeline:
Looking to start development ASAP. Final MVP expexted within 2-3 weeks.

💶 Budget:
Budget for this MVP phase is under €750 but negotiable, so I’m looking for someone who is efficient, experienced, and understands how to work smart with off-the-shelf tools like GPT APIs, Pinecone, LangChain, or similar.

🌍 Developer Preferences:

Please mention your timezone in your application.

	•	Your availability and expected timeframe for delivery

📌 Overview
We are working on Replit AI platform to create a knitting app. 
The app works well for one project at a time, but there is a critical bug when switching between projects that causes the wrong data to load or overwrite another project.

We need your help to trace and fix the bug safely, preserving existing project and ensuring stable behavior.

🐛 The Bug
When users go to the Home screen and click “View Pattern” for Project B, they see the written pattern from Project A (most recently edited) instead of the correct one.

Cause (confirmed):
The app uses per-project localStorage, but the current implementation of GeneratePattern.tsx and getDynamicValues() falls back to empty or incorrect token values if any required keys are missing.

This causes valid token placeholders (like [Pattern title], [Yarn brand]) to be replaced with empty strings — and these are then auto-saved, wiping out good data.

This appears to be a race condition between pattern generation and loading state.

✅ What’s Already Built
Project creation flow (name, sizing, yarns, needles, tension)
Dynamic overview generator (calculates stitch/row numbers)
Written pattern generator using token replacement system
Export options: PDF, Word, Text
LocalStorage per project using projectId
Working UI with pattern editor, tabs, charts, etc.

🔧 What Needs to Be Done
The goal is to make sure when the user clicks 'View Pattern' a correct written instruction appears with correct token data shown in the pattern. 

🧠 Ideal Candidate
Strong experience with React, TypeScript, and localStorage/state management
Familiarity with debouncing, race condition debugging, or pattern/template-driven UI
Comfortable debugging an existing codebase without breaking other flows
Bonus if you know knitting

Your expertise will help streamline the proposal process and enhance efficiency. Build a Shipley-Based AutoRFP System for GovCon (Compliance Matrix → Color Reviews → AI Drafting in AppFlowy → DOCX Export)
Project Type: Fixed-price with milestones
Seeking: 1 senior full-stack engineer

Goal
Create an end-to-end AutoRFP web app tailored to U.S. federal contracting that:

ingests RFPs (PDF/Word/HTML/Excel/ZIP),

generates a Compliance Matrix keyed to Section L/M/C and FAR/DFARS cites,

supports Shipley color reviews (Blue/Pink/Red/Gold/Green) with tasks and approvals,

captures win themes/storylines, and

produces AI-drafted proposal content inside AppFlowy for collaborative editing and export to Word (.docx).

Must-Have Capabilities (Scope)

RFP Ingestion & Parsing

Upload large, messy RFPs (scanned + digital). OCR where needed.

Shred to sections/clauses; extract shall/ must statements; FAR/DFARS references.

Maintain source traceability (page/paragraph anchors) for every extracted requirement.

Compliance Matrix Generator

Auto-build matrix (Req ID, Text, Section, FAR/DFARS cite, Eval factor, Volume/Section, Owner, Status).

Subcontractor Flowdown clause exporter

Edit in app; export to Excel/CSV.

Accuracy target: ≥90% capture of discrete compliance statements on a 200+ page RFP (measured against SME baseline).

Shipley Color Reviews Workflow

Configurable Blue, Pink, Red, Gold, Green gates with checklists, assignments, due dates, comment threads, and pass/fail.

Review packets auto-assembled from the matrix + current draft.

Scorecards to predict evaluator scoring at Red Team.

Win Themes & Storyboarding

Space to author win themes, discriminators, proofs.

Link themes to requirements and specific draft sections; coverage heatmap.

AI Drafting & Content Reuse

Upload legacy proposals, resumes, past performance, and boilerplate to a secure library.

RAG generation: draft proposal sections aligned to Section L/M, annotated with sources.

Style controls (tone, reading level) and prompt templates for Pink/Red rewrites.

Authoring in AppFlowy (Collaboration)

Create synchronized AppFlowy pages for volumes/sections with real-time co-editing.

Round-trip sync between the app and AppFlowy (titles/blocks/attachments/comments).

Export to Word (.docx) with required headings, TOC, page breaks, and style mapping.

Governance, Audit, and Security

User roles (Capture/PM/Writer/Reviewer/SME/Exec).

Full audit trail (who changed what, when).

Data isolation per opportunity; encryption in transit/at rest.

Technical Expectations
Parsing/OCR: unstructured.io / pdfminer.six / textract + Tesseract/AWS Textract/Azure DI (your recommendation).

Backend: Python (FastAPI) or Node (NestJS).

LLM/RAG: LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent; embeddings + vector store (pgvector/Qdrant/Weaviate). Bring your own strategy for model abstraction (OpenAI/Azure/Anthropic/local LLM).

Frontend: Next.js/React with role-based UI for matrix, tasks, and reviews.

AppFlowy integration: use available plugin surfaces and/or AppFlowy Cloud endpoints; where native DOCX export is limited, implement server-side Markdown→DOCX (Pandoc / python-docx) with style templates.

Storage: Postgres (primary), S3-compatible object store.

Auth: SSO-ready (Auth0/Clerk/Keycloak).

Hosting: Cloud of your choice; IaC preferred.

Deliverables
Running web app with:

Upload/parsing pipeline with traceability

Editable Compliance Matrix + CSV/XLSX export

Color review workflow + scorecards

Win themes module + coverage map

AI drafting with citation back to source library and RFP anchors

AppFlowy collaborative authoring + DOCX export

Admin console (users, roles, libraries, model/API keys, logs).

Test suite + performance benchmarks (see acceptance).

Deployment scripts (Docker + IaC) and handover docs.

Training videos (≤ 6 short clips) and quick-start guide.

jobs.description:
I’m seeking a talented web developer (or small team) to build a modern, user-friendly web application that lets users track and redeem “brownie points” with each other. The concept is similar to a chore or task tracker, but designed for couples or small groups to encourage positive interactions and reward one another.

Key Features & Requirements:

 User Groups:
 Users must be able to form groups (e.g., husband and wife, roommates, friends) and interact within their group only.

 Task Posting & Negotiation:
 Users can create tasks with a point value and assign them to a user in their group, which the other member can negotiate or approve before they appear on the task board.
 (e.g., “Take out the garbage – 3 points”; the other user can suggest a different value before accepting.)

 Recurrence & Redemption Settings:
 Tasks can be set as one-time, repeatable (infinite), or limited to a certain number of completions.

 Notifications:

 When a task is posted, the user assigned is notified.

 When a task is marked as done, the user that assigned it is notified for approval.

 The assigner can add a bonus (percentage or fixed value) upon completion approval.

 Points & Rewards System:

 Points are awarded for approved tasks. Rewards can be created by the person wanting the reward, or by the person offering the reward. Approval is needed either way by the other user.
 Users can redeem points for rewards created by the other person.
 When a reward is redeemed, it’s added to the responsible person’s TODO list.


 Media Attachments:
 Users can attach images, videos, or audio to completed tasks. These should be viewable in-app (not as downloads). 

User Flow Example:

 Wife posts: “Take out the garbage” (3 points)

 Husband approves task

 Husband completes and marks task as done, and uploads picture proof

 Wife confirms completion, points awarded

 Husband redeems “Foot rub” reward

 “Foot rub” is added to wife’s TODO list

App Pages:

 Login/Register: Secure account creation with encrypted passwords

 Dashboard: View users points, see/approve pending approvals
Links to: create tasks, view tasks assigned to you, view TODO, View rewards, create rewards, view completed tasks that you assigned (Spot to view attached media)

 Create Task: Name, description, point value, recurrence settings

 Available Tasks: List and view details of tasks to complete

 TODO: Rewards the user needs to fulfill

 View Rewards: Rewards available to redeem

 Create Reward: Create new rewards for other group members (Title, description, point cost, recurrance settings)

Technical Considerations:

 Frontend: Clean, modern, mobile-friendly UI (specify your preferred framework in your proposal)

 Backend: Python preferred (Flask, Django, or FastAPI), with split Python and HTML files for each feature

 Data: Must work over both mobile data and WiFi. Include nginx files as needed

 Security: Encrypted passwords and secure authentication

 Hosting: App will run on my Unraid server with a publicly accessible domain and ample storage

Notifications: Served by any free push notification service that works on android. FCM, Pushbullet, etc.

Bonus:

 Experience building similar task-tracking, habit, or reward apps

 UI/UX design skills for a modern, friendly interface

Delivery expectations
All necessary script and html/js files packaged ready for deployment

Tech stack: React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Vite, localStorage (no backend), Rich Text Editor

Nice to have: Knitting knowledge

📌 Overview
We are working on Replit AI platform to create a knitting app. 
The app works well for one project at a time, but there is a critical bug when switching between projects that causes the wrong data to load or overwrite another project.

We need your help to trace and fix the bug safely, preserving existing project and ensuring stable behavior.

🐛 The Bug
When users go to the Home screen and click “View Pattern” for Project B, they see the written pattern from Project A (most recently edited) instead of the correct one.

Cause (confirmed):
The app uses per-project localStorage, but the current implementation of GeneratePattern.tsx and getDynamicValues() falls back to empty or incorrect token values if any required keys are missing.

This causes valid token placeholders (like [Pattern title], [Yarn brand]) to be replaced with empty strings — and these are then auto-saved, wiping out good data.

This appears to be a race condition between pattern generation and loading state.

✅ What’s Already Built
Project creation flow (name, sizing, yarns, needles, tension)
Dynamic overview generator (calculates stitch/row numbers)
Written pattern generator using token replacement system
Export options: PDF, Word, Text
LocalStorage per project using projectId
Working UI with pattern editor, tabs, charts, etc.

🔧 What Needs to Be Done
The goal is to make sure when the user clicks 'View Pattern' a correct written instruction appears with correct token data shown in the pattern. 

🧠 Ideal Candidate
Strong experience with React, TypeScript, and localStorage/state management
Familiarity with debouncing, race condition debugging, or pattern/template-driven UI
Comfortable debugging an existing codebase without breaking other flows
Bonus if you know knitting

React (functional components, hooks)

TypeScript

Tailwind CSS

Vite

PDF / DOCX export libraries

jobs.title: Android App Enhancement: Barcode scanning app with PC sync
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Android developer with expertise in automation, cross-device communication, and user interface design to enhance an existing barcode scanning Android app and integrate it with a POS system. 
The app, built using Google’s ML Kit and Claude the Great, successfully scans 15-digit barcodes while ignoring irrelevant ones. We need your help to complete the project by adding seamless data transfer, automation, and a scalable configuration interface for multi-location setups.

The purpose of this app is to scan a bunch of barcodes when the camera app from an Android device is facing it because currently it takes a long time us to scan one barcode at a time whereas with the open source Google ml kit we are able to simply scan a bunch of devices all at once.

Project Scope:
Current State: The Android app scans 15-digit barcodes (Barcode 1) and ignores others (e.g., Barcode 2 or non-15-digit codes). It’s functional, built with Google’s ML Kit, and source files are available.

Objective: 
After scanning barcodes and selecting “Done” or “Complete,” the app transfers the data to a designated computer running a basic software-based POS system. The POS system requires navigating 3-4 menus to reach an inventory scanning page, which opens a Chrome browser with a text field for barcode input.

Key Requirements:
Data Transfer: Implement a reliable method to send scanned barcodes from the Android app to a specific computer (may or may not be on the same network). 

Proposed methods include:
Email (e.g., Gmail) with date/time logging, paired with a Chrome extension to auto-populate the POS field.
Local Wi-Fi or network-based transfer.
Public API (e.g., via GitHub or Firebase).
Other creative solutions (e.g., WebSocket, cloud-based sync, or FTP).

Automation: 
Automate barcode input into the POS system’s Chrome browser field with a 2-second delay between entries.
Device-Specific Sync: Ensure the app syncs only with the designated computer for each of our three locations, preventing data from being sent to incorrect devices.

Configuration Interface: 
Develop a user-friendly interface for:
Target App (Android): Allow configuration of the target PC (e.g., via IP address, unique ID, or QR code) to ensure accurate pairing.

Target Software (PC): Provide a lightweight application or script on the PC to capture barcodes, manage sync settings, and automate Chrome input (or other methods). 
The interface should simplify setup for new locations.

Barcode Filtering: 

Confirm the app only scans barcodes under “Barcode 1” and stops scanning when “Barcode 2” is detected.
Installation: Enable easy installation of the app as an APK on Android devices and the PC software, with simple configuration to pair with the correct POS computer. The solution must support scalability for future locations beyond the initial three.

Scalability Goal: 
The configuration interface should make it easy to deploy the app and PC software at additional locations with minimal setup.

Deliverables:
A mock-up version of the enhanced app, PC software, and configuration interface within 3-4 days for testing.
A fully functional solution within 1-2 weeks, incorporating trial feedback.

Documentation for setup, configuration, and scaling to new locations.

Source code for the app, PC software, and any scripts (e.g., Chrome extension or server-side code).

Provided Resources:
Full source code of the current Android app (working flawlessly for barcode scanning).
Sample images of products with 15-digit barcodes for testing will be provided including products.

Details about the POS system’s navigation and Chrome-based input field.

Preferred Qualifications:
Strong experience with Android development (Java/Kotlin) and Google’s ML Kit.

Expertise in cross-device communication (e.g., Wi-Fi, API, email automation, or cloud-based solutions).
Proficiency in building user-friendly configuration interfaces for Android and PC applications.
Familiarity with Chrome extensions or browser automation (e.g., Selenium, Puppeteer).

Ability to propose and implement robust, scalable solutions.

Proven track record of delivering projects quickly and iteratively.

Additional Notes:
We are open to creative solutions! Please include in your proposal:

Your recommended approach for data transfer, automation, and the configuration interface (e.g., email, Wi-Fi, API, etc.).

How your solution ensures scalability for future locations.
A brief plan for delivering a mock-up in 3-4 days.
Budget and timeline are flexible but must align with the 3-4 day mock-up and 1-2 week completion goals.
Experience with POS systems or inventory management is a plus but not required.

How to Apply: Please submit:
A brief overview of your relevant experience.
Your proposed solution for data transfer, automation, and the configuration interface.
Suggestions for ensuring scalability across multiple locations.

Links to similar projects or portfolio work.
Your availability to start immediately and deliver a mock-up within 3-4 days.

We’re excited to collaborate with a professional who can deliver a scalable, user-friendly solution quickly and efficiently!

Candidates that we feel like are good fit will be provided a video of everything here in a quick 2-3 minute format so you can see what you're dealing with and also have a better idea.

ingests RFPs (PDF/Word/HTML/Excel/ZIP),

Subcontractor Flowdown clause exporter

Edit in app; export to Excel/CSV.

Review packets auto-assembled from the matrix + current draft.

Scorecards to predict evaluator scoring at Red Team.

Win Themes & Storyboarding

Style controls (tone, reading level) and prompt templates for Pink/Red rewrites.

Authoring in AppFlowy (Collaboration)

jobs.description:
I’m seeking a talented web developer (or small team) to build a modern, user-friendly web application that lets users track and redeem “brownie points” with each other. The concept is similar to a chore or task tracker, but designed for couples or small groups to encourage positive interactions and reward one another.

Key Features & Requirements:

 User Groups:
 Users must be able to form groups (e.g., husband and wife, roommates, friends) and interact within their group only.

 Task Posting & Negotiation:
 Users can create tasks with a point value and assign them to a user in their group, which the other member can negotiate or approve before they appear on the task board.
 (e.g., “Take out the garbage – 3 points”; the other user can suggest a different value before accepting.)

 Recurrence & Redemption Settings:
 Tasks can be set as one-time, repeatable (infinite), or limited to a certain number of completions.

 Notifications:

 When a task is posted, the user assigned is notified.

 When a task is marked as done, the user that assigned it is notified for approval.

 The assigner can add a bonus (percentage or fixed value) upon completion approval.

 Points & Rewards System:

 Points are awarded for approved tasks. Rewards can be created by the person wanting the reward, or by the person offering the reward. Approval is needed either way by the other user.
 Users can redeem points for rewards created by the other person.
 When a reward is redeemed, it’s added to the responsible person’s TODO list.


 Media Attachments:
 Users can attach images, videos, or audio to completed tasks. These should be viewable in-app (not as downloads). 

User Flow Example:

 Wife posts: “Take out the garbage” (3 points)

 Husband approves task

 Husband completes and marks task as done, and uploads picture proof

 Wife confirms completion, points awarded

 Husband redeems “Foot rub” reward

 “Foot rub” is added to wife’s TODO list

App Pages:

 Login/Register: Secure account creation with encrypted passwords

 Dashboard: View users points, see/approve pending approvals
Links to: create tasks, view tasks assigned to you, view TODO, View rewards, create rewards, view completed tasks that you assigned (Spot to view attached media)

 Create Task: Name, description, point value, recurrence settings

 Available Tasks: List and view details of tasks to complete

 TODO: Rewards the user needs to fulfill

 View Rewards: Rewards available to redeem

 Create Reward: Create new rewards for other group members (Title, description, point cost, recurrance settings)

Technical Considerations:

 Frontend: Clean, modern, mobile-friendly UI (specify your preferred framework in your proposal)

 Backend: Python preferred (Flask, Django, or FastAPI), with split Python and HTML files for each feature

 Data: Must work over both mobile data and WiFi. Include nginx files as needed

 Security: Encrypted passwords and secure authentication

 Hosting: App will run on my Unraid server with a publicly accessible domain and ample storage

Notifications: Served by any free push notification service that works on android. FCM, Pushbullet, etc.

Bonus:

 Experience building similar task-tracking, habit, or reward apps

 UI/UX design skills for a modern, friendly interface

Delivery expectations
All necessary script and html/js files packaged ready for deployment
questions: Describe your approach to testing and improving QA

Stabilizing a Microservices Ecosystem: You will diagnose and fix complex communication and data format issues between our main Laravel application and our various backend Python/FastAPI services, ensuring seamless and reliable integration.
Building System Reliability and Health Checks: You will design and implement automated health checks and cron jobs to monitor external services and internal queues. Your work will ensure our systems can self-heal from common issues like stuck jobs or stale infrastructure data.
Hardening Security and Enforcing Best Practices: You will lead the effort to identify and eradicate security vulnerabilities and implement best practices for secure configuration management across all our projects.

An Architectural Thinker: You don't just patch bugs; you understand the root cause and can re-architect a feature to prevent entire classes of problems. You are energized by solving complex, interconnected problems.

A Full-Stack QA Veteran: You are an expert in end-to-end testing with frameworks like Cypress or Playwright and have a strong background in unit testing (PHPUnit, Pest, Vitest/Jest).

An AI Power User: You use AI tools like Gemini and Cursor to accelerate your workflow (drafting tests, refactoring code, surfacing blind spots) but still review every line with a critical eye.

jobs.title: Expert MedusaJS Developer Needed for Advanced Multi-Vendor Marketplace Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a top-tier MedusaJS expert to lead the backend development of an ambitious new e-commerce platform. This project aims to become the leading solution for small and medium-sized businesses in a key South Asian market.

The Vision:

Our platform is a hybrid model that combines two powerful concepts:

 A Central Marketplace: A main website where customers can browse, search, and purchase products from a wide variety of independent sellers in a single, unified shopping cart (similar to Amazon).

 Individual Vendor Storefronts: A subscription-based service where sellers can create their own beautiful, fully-functional online store with its own branding and the ability to use a custom domain (similar to Shopify).

This entire ecosystem will be powered by a single, robust MedusaJS backend. We need an expert who understands the Medusa architecture deeply and can build the custom logic required to make this vision a reality.

Core Responsibilities:

 Architect the Multi-Vendor System: Design and build the core multi-vendor logic within Medusa, including creating a custom "Vendor" module and linking it to products, users, and orders.

 Implement Mulit Tenant / Individual Storefront Logic: Leverage Medusa to create and manage thousands of isolated vendor storefronts, each with its own product catalog and settings.

 Develop Custom Local Integrations: This is a critical task. You will build custom Medusa providers from scratch for:

 Payment Gateways: Integrating with popular local payment services that are not available as standard plugins.

 Shipping & Fulfillment: Integrating with local logistics and courier companies to provide real-time shipping rates and fulfillment services.

 Build a Dedicated Vendor Panel API: Create the necessary Admin API endpoints to power a separate, custom-built dashboard for our vendors, allowing them to manage their products, view their orders, and control their store settings.

 Implement Complex Order Management: Develop the backend logic for splitting a single customer order into multiple sub-orders for each vendor, ensuring each seller only sees and processes their part of the sale.

 Contribute to Custom Domain Strategy: Work with our team to implement the backend logic required to serve different storefronts based on the incoming domain.

 Ensure Scalability and Performance: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented TypeScript code, following MedusaJS best practices to ensure the platform is secure and scalable.


Required Skills and Experience:

 Expert-level proficiency in MedusaJS. You must have demonstrable experience building complex projects with Medusa and understand its core concepts (Modules, Services, Subscribers, Lifecycles) inside and out.

 Strong background in Node.js and TypeScript.

 Deep experience with e-commerce architecture, particularly with multi-vendor marketplace and/or platform-as-a-service (PaaS) models.

 Proven experience integrating third-party APIs, especially for payment and shipping services. You should be comfortable reading technical API documentation and building robust integrations.

 Proficiency with PostgreSQL and designing relational data models.

 Experience building and securing RESTful APIs.


Highly Desirable (Bonus Points):

 Familiarity with the MedusaJS frontend ecosystem (Next.js storefront).

 Experience with cloud deployment and infrastructure (Docker, AWS, Vercel).

 Previous experience building a SaaS or marketplace platform.

What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a proactive problem-solver who can take ownership of the backend development. You should be a strong communicator, able to collaborate with our frontend team and provide clear technical guidance. This is a foundational role in a high-potential startup, offering the chance to build a market-defining product from the ground up.

How to Apply:

Please start your proposal with the phrase "Medusa Marketplace" so we know you have read the entire post.

In your application, please provide the following:

 A brief summary of your experience with MedusaJS, specifically on projects that required significant customization.

 Links to at least two complex backend projects you were a lead or key contributor on. Please specify your role.

 Answer the following architectural question: Our platform's core challenge is supporting thousands of vendors, where each vendor has an isolated storefront and the option to use a custom domain (e.g., their-own-shop.com).

 Please outline your technical strategy for achieving this using MedusaJS. Specifically address:

 Data Isolation: How would you architect the backend to ensure Vendor A can never access Vendor B's products, orders, or customer data? Mention the specific MedusaJS modules/features you would use.

 Individual Storefronts: How would a single frontend application dynamically display the correct branding, theme, and product catalog when a user visits vendor-a.ourplatform.com versus vendor-b.ourplatform.com?

 Custom Domains: From a high-level backend and infrastructure perspective, what is the process for mapping a vendor's external domain to their specific storefront on our platform?

jobs.title: Develop Lightweight Utility to Disable BD PROCHOT on Windows Laptop (ThrottleStop-like behavior)
jobs.description:
I am looking for a developer to create a minimal, invisible utility that disables the BD PROCHOT limit on Intel laptops, to replicate the behavior of ThrottleStop, but without its GUI or extra features.

This is required to unlock full CPU performance on a Windows 10/11 x64 laptop that is running without a battery. Many laptops throttle CPU speeds due to thermal/fan/battery logic (EC, DPTF, etc.), even when the CPU is cool. ThrottleStop solves this by disabling BD PROCHOT — we want the same effect but with a cleaner, minimal binary suitable for automation or EFI integration.

Requirements:
- Deliver a standalone .exe or EFI binary that:
- Disables the BD PROCHOT bit
- Runs silently (no console, no UI, no systray icon)
- Consumes minimal CPU and memory (less than 5%)
- Is stable and does not cause BSODs or antivirus alerts
- Intel compatible
- Work on Windows 10/11 x64, on laptops without batteries
- Be executed at boot time (via Task Scheduler or via EFI chainloader)

jobs.title: iOS Developer (Swift or React Native) for Camera App MVP
jobs.description:
**Description:**

We are seeking an experienced freelance mobile developer for a project-based contract to build the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a new iOS camera application.

The core of the app involves a custom camera interface and communication with a backend API. We have the backend development and AI modeling handled internally. Your role will be to build the user-facing iOS application that provides a seamless and intuitive experience.

This is a focused, project-based role to get our V1 app to market. We are looking for a professional who can deliver high-quality, clean, and maintainable code.

**Key MVP Responsibilities:**

- Build a high-quality iOS application from the ground up.
- Implement a clean, native-feeling camera interface with standard controls (shutter, flip camera).
- Integrate with our backend REST API: The app will send an image taken by the user to the API and then receive structured data (text and URLs) in response.
- Create the UI screens to display the captured photo and the data returned from the API.
- Implement a feature where simple text received from the API is displayed on the camera screen.
- Integrate an in-app purchase system for a freemium subscription model (e.g., using RevenueCat or StoreKit).
- Implement standard features: saving a final image to the device's photo library and using the native iOS Share Sheet.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

- **Primary Skill (Choose one):**
 - **Native iOS:** Proven experience building and shipping apps using Swift & SwiftUI/UIKit.
 - **Cross-Platform:** Deep expertise in React Native, with a strong portfolio of high-performance iOS apps and verifiable experience integrating with native iOS APIs (especially for the camera).
- **iOS Camera API:** Demonstrable experience with AVFoundation. This is a critical requirement for the role. You must be comfortable building and controlling a custom camera interface.
- **API Integration:** Strong proficiency with REST APIs, handling JSON, and managing asynchronous network requests.
- **In-App Subscriptions:** Verifiable experience implementing and testing in-app subscriptions on the Apple App Store.
- **Professionalism:** Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently to meet project deadlines.

**How to Apply:**

To show you've read the entire post, please start your proposal with the word **"MOMENT"**.

In your proposal, please provide the following:

1. A link to your portfolio or 1-2 specific iOS apps in the App Store that you have built. Please describe your role in their development.
2. What is your primary development expertise (Native iOS with Swift, or a cross-platform framework)? If cross-platform, briefly describe your experience connecting to native iOS features like the camera.
3. Describe a challenge you've faced with iOS camera integration in a past project and how you solved it.

We are looking forward to reviewing your application and finding a great developer to build this with.

jobs.description:
I’m not sure if this is the right job description but in order for you to find out exactly I mean exactly what I want. You’re gonna have to go through the. Listkit sign up process and watch their demo videos and speak to one of their sales people on all the features of the website. I want the exact same set up as they have. Here’s a description of it somewhat so it can’t be 100% right you have to go off what you find on how list kit is doing it. 
Upwork Job Description: Build a B2B Lead Generation and Cold Email Automation Platform with Domain Purchasing and Warm-Up System
Job Title: Full-Stack Developer to Build a B2B Lead Generation and AI-Powered Cold Email Platform (ListKit Clone)
Budget: $4,000–$8,000 (negotiable based on experience and deliverables)
Job Type: Fixed-price or hourly (please specify your preference)
Description:
We are seeking an experienced full-stack developer to create a scalable, user-friendly B2B lead generation and cold email automation platform, modeled after ListKit.io. The platform must provide a searchable database of verified B2B leads (company and contact data) with manual filtering by SIC codes for industries and job roles (e.g., owners, founders, partners), followed by automatic lead scrubbing/verification. It should include a 3–4 email sequence with AI-driven response detection (positive replies trigger a VSL link and appointment button), and a system for users to purchase hundreds/thousands of domain addresses directly through the platform, with automated warm-up and inbox rotation for high-volume sending (e.g., 10,000 emails/day). The system must be fully automated, intuitive for end users, and include a seamless signup process with payment integration. Legal compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM) is critical to ensure ethical data use and email deliverability.
Project Scope and Key Deliverables:
	1	Lead Database and Search Interface:
	◦	Build a searchable database of B2B leads (company names, domains, industries, locations, employee counts, contact emails/phones).
	◦	Allow users to manually select SIC codes to filter by industries, then choose specific job roles (e.g., owners, founders, partners, etc.).
	◦	Once selections are made, automatically process and scrub the leads through a verification system (e.g., triple-verified email/phone validation via NeverBounce or similar APIs).
	◦	Source data ethically via APIs (e.g., Hunter.io, Clearbit/Breeze Intelligence, or OpenCorporates) or public directories (no scraping of restricted sites like LinkedIn).
	◦	Create a user-friendly web interface (similar to ListKit’s dashboard) for users to apply these filters and export leads to CSV.
	◦	Ensure scalability for 10,000–50,000 leads/month with fast query performance.
	2	Cold Email Automation System:
	◦	Develop a 3–4 email sequence for cold outreach, fully automated and customizable by users.
	◦	Integrate an AI-powered response detection system (e.g., using NLP models like Hugging Face or OpenAI API) to analyze replies and identify positive sentiment (e.g., interest or engagement).
	◦	For positive replies, auto-trigger a response with a VSL link (hosted on platform or external like Vimeo) and an appointment booking button (integrate with Calendly or similar).
	◦	Allow users to set up campaigns via a simple UI (e.g., drag-and-drop or form-based sequence builder).
	◦	Integrate with third-party email service providers (ESPs) like Amazon SES, SendGrid, or Mailgun for high deliverability (support multiple accounts/IPs for volume).
	◦	Include deliverability features: email warmup, bounce handling, and spam score checks.
	3	Domain Purchasing and Email Warm-Up System:
	◦	Create a system for users to buy domains in bulk (hundreds/thousands) via an integrated registrar API (e.g., Porkbun, Namecheap, or GoDaddy).
	◦	Automate domain setup for email sending (SPF, DKIM, DMARC configuration).
	◦	Implement automated warm-up for each domain’s inbox (e.g., gradual sending via Smartlead or Warmbox API) to build sender reputation.
	◦	Manage inbox rotation across domains to distribute email volume (e.g., 10,000/day) and avoid spam filters.
	◦	Provide a dashboard for users to monitor domain status, warm-up progress, and sending performance.
	4	User Signup and Onboarding:
	◦	Build a seamless signup flow with email/password, Google SSO, or similar.
	◦	Integrate a payment gateway (e.g., Stripe) for subscription plans (e.g., $97–$500/month tiers based on lead/email volume).
	◦	Create an intuitive onboarding process: users can input campaign details, connect ESP accounts, purchase domains, select SIC codes and roles, and start searching/sending within minutes.
	◦	Ensure mobile-responsive design for dashboard and campaign management.
	5	Backend and Infrastructure:
	◦	Use a robust tech stack (e.g., Python/Django or Node.js for backend, React/Vue.js for frontend, PostgreSQL/MongoDB for database).
	◦	Host on AWS, Heroku, or similar (leverage free tiers initially, scalable to handle growth).
	◦	Implement secure API integrations for data sourcing, verification, email sending, AI, and domain purchasing.
	◦	Ensure data encryption and compliance with privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).
	6	Automation and Scalability:
	◦	Automate the entire pipeline: lead filtering/scrubbing → verification → storage → email sending → response handling.
	◦	Use tools like Make.com or custom cron jobs for scheduling daily lead refreshes and campaign triggers.
	◦	Optimize for high-volume email sending (10,000 emails/day per user) with minimal downtime.
	7	Compliance and Ethics:
	◦	Ensure all data sourcing complies with legal standards and site terms (e.g., check robots.txt, avoid restricted platforms).
	◦	Implement opt-in tracking and unsubscribe options for email campaigns.
	◦	Provide documentation for compliance with data privacy regulations.
Required Skills:
	•	Full-stack development (Python, JavaScript, or similar; frameworks like Django/Flask, React/Vue).
	•	Experience with API integrations (Hunter.io, NeverBounce, Amazon SES, Stripe, Calendly, Porkbun, Smartlead, etc.).
	•	Familiarity with AI/NLP for email response analysis (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI, or custom models).
	•	Knowledge of email deliverability best practices (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, inbox rotation).
	•	Experience building SaaS platforms with user dashboards, payment systems, and domain management.
	•	Understanding of GDPR, CCPA, and CAN-SPAM compliance.
Preferred Qualifications:
	•	Prior work on lead generation or cold email tools (please share examples).
	•	Experience with SIC code filtering, job role targeting, and lead scrubbing systems.
	•	Familiarity with AWS/Heroku for scalable hosting.
	•	Ability to design clean, modern UI/UX (similar to ListKit’s professional aesthetic).
	•	Knowledge of B2B sales funnels and cold outreach strategies.
Deliverables:
	•	Fully functional platform with lead database (including SIC/role filtering and scrubbing), search UI, email automation, and domain purchasing/warm-up system.
	•	Source code with clear documentation (hosted on GitHub or similar).
	•	Admin panel for managing users, leads, domains, and subscriptions.
	•	Compliance guide for data sourcing and email sending.
	•	1-month post-launch support for bug fixes and tweaks.
Timeline:
	•	Estimated completion: 4–8 weeks.
	•	Milestones:
	◦	Week 1–2: Database, SIC/role filtering, and API integrations.
	◦	Week 3–4: Email automation, AI response system, and domain purchasing/warm-up.
	◦	Week 5–6: UI/UX and signup flow.
	◦	Week 7–8: Testing, compliance checks, and deployment.
Budget and Payment:
	•	Fixed price preferred ($4,000–$8,000, negotiable based on scope and experience).
	•	Hourly rate considered (please provide estimate and hours).
	•	Payment via Upwork Escrow, released in milestones (e.g., 30% after database/filtering, 30% after automation/domain system, 40% after final delivery).
How to Apply:
	•	Submit your portfolio with relevant SaaS or automation projects.
	•	Provide a brief plan for building this system (tech stack, APIs, timeline).
	•	Share experience with lead gen, email automation, AI response detection, or domain management.
	•	Include your hourly rate or fixed-price quote.
	•	Confirm your understanding of compliance requirements.
Additional Notes:
	•	The platform must be intuitive for non-technical users, with a focus on automation and ease of use from the user end (e.g., simple SIC code selection, role picking, and automatic scrubbing).
	•	We aim to replicate ListKit’s core functionality (lead search with industry/role filtering, verified data, email automation, domain handling) with the added AI-driven email sequence feature.
	•	Preference for developers who can suggest cost-effective APIs/tools and optimize for scalability.
	•	Ongoing maintenance work may be available post-launch.
Contact: Please message with any questions or clarifications before submitting your proposal. We’re excited to work with a skilled developer to bring this vision to life!

jobs.title: WooCommerce/FedEx Shipping-Tracking/PluginHive
jobs.description:
1.	FedEx Package Tracking Using PluginHive plugin for FedEx Tracking.

What we have now: When an order is placed it processes through WooCommerce as expected and then when FedEx picks up the actual product from the client. That is what triggers the FedEx tracking link to be sent to the customer. The email that is sent comes from FedEx and has the FedEx branding.

What we need: We want the same trigger to send the tracking link email but we don’t want it to have the FedEx branding or to come from their email system. We have the FedEx PluginHive Licensed Plugin that will allow for a custom email to be set up with our branding and come from our email. The plugin should be able to add the proper FedEx tracking url to the email goes out to the customer.



2.	Label Printing on the admin side of our website.

What we have now: When an order is completed through the website. WooCommerce is connected to FedEx and they can print labels when logged into their FedEx account.

Currently we have custom shipping rates that the customer receives based on order amount. That is controlled by a different plugin and is working as expected.

On the admin side I have set the size boxes they use to ship automatically for any order. They are the FedEx Small Box through FedEx Extra Large Box. Those boxes are checked and correct.

I have the shipping set to FedEx 2 Day AM and FedEx 2 Day. The client only uses 2 Day Shipping at this time.

They only Ship on Tuesdays and Thursdays. That information is already set on the website admin side.


What we need: When an order is place through the website, we want the FedEx Label plugin from PluginHive to automatically create the label so that we can print directly from the backend of WooCommerce vs having to login into our FedEx account on their website to print labels.

Right now, the system does not automatically create the shipment box and use the customer information to create the label. That is our goal and then we can just mass print a bunch of labels from the backend of the website vs having to go to FedEx and print them one by one.



Additional details:
We will need to know how you plan to make the changes and make sure all packaging labels are correct, as well as the Email for Shipping Tracking to customer is correct.

We are hosted on Siteground and they have the ability for you to set up a staging area so we don’t interfere with the live website.

In order to work on this project we will need you to be expert working with WooCommerce, FedEx and PluginHive

We have 4 Pluginhive plugins that work with FedEx
1.	ph-hide-woocommerce-shipping-methods-premium
2.	ph-woocommerce-shipment-tracking
3.	wf-estimated-delivery-for-woocommerce
4.	fedex-woocommerce-shipping

The person for this job MUST have worked with these Plugin Hive plugins, FedEx and be able to accomplish the goals outlined above.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer for Seamless Chat Experience with LangGraph Interrupts
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented front-end developer who can help us build a conversational UI powered by LangGraph’s Deployments API. The focus of this project is to ensure that the chat interface behaves like a standard messaging experience, even though the backend relies on LangGraph’s interrupt mechanism and a complex graph structure with nested subgraphs and agents.

Our current implementation is partially functional — users can initiate a conversation, and the interrupt system does resume the graph appropriately after user input. However, the problem lies in how messages (especially interrupt prompts and user responses) are being displayed and persisted in the UI. The chat appears broken or incomplete because only the initial message is visible, and follow-up interactions through interrupts aren't reflected properly.

We're looking for someone who:
- Has hands-on experience working with LangGraph, especially using the Deployments API, interrupts, threads, and checkpoints.
- Understands how to manage state updates in a frontend application, particularly in the context of streaming or event-driven architectures.
- Can troubleshoot UI-related inconsistencies and implement a real-time, seamless message flow for users.
- Ideally has built or contributed to a custom chat interface before, especially one involving streaming APIs or agent-based architectures.

Your responsibilities:
- Review and refine the current message-handling logic to ensure all interactions (initial messages, interrupt prompts, and user replies) appear in the chat thread.
- Coordinate with the backend team to understand the structure of interrupt handling.
- Update and improve the chat interface so that it mimics a natural, back-and-forth messaging experience, masking the complexity of the underlying LangGraph architecture.

Nice to have:
- Experience working with LangChain or agent-based systems.
- Familiarity with frontend frameworks like React, Next.js, or similar.
- Previous work with streaming APIs or event-driven UIs.

Should be available in EST time zone.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Mobile App Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled full-stack mobile app developer to help us build a cross-platform mobile application (initially focusing on iOS). The app is designed to assist users in planning their meals and saving money by comparing supermarket prices. The ideal candidate will have experience with mobile app development, backend services, API integration, and web scraping.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop a Cross-Platform App: Build a responsive and user-friendly app with a beautiful UI. The app will initially focus on iOS development using Flutter or React Native.

Backend Setup: Set up a secure backend using either Firebase or AWS Amplify for user authentication, data storage, and real-time syncing.

Web Scraping Integration: Implement a solution for scraping real-time supermarket prices across different countries. The scraping should be efficient, and the results should be cached for improved performance.

API Integrations: Integrate third-party APIs to provide users with recipe search functionality and manage user-specific data such as meal plans, saved recipes, and shopping lists.

Affiliate System: Build or integrate an affiliate tracking system that allows affiliates to view their earnings and track referrals.

Notifications: Set up push notifications for meal prep reminders and updates on price changes.

Performance Optimization: Ensure the app remains responsive with sub-2-second load times, especially when fetching price data.

Required Skills:

Mobile App Development: Proficiency in Flutter or React Native with experience building cross-platform apps.

Backend Services: Experience with Firebase or AWS Amplify for handling user authentication, real-time data storage, and cloud functions.

Web Scraping: Knowledge of web scraping techniques using tools like Scrapy, Puppeteer, or BeautifulSoup to scrape price data from supermarket websites.

API Integration: Experience integrating third-party APIs (e.g., recipe search, geolocation).

Database Management: Familiarity with NoSQL and SQL databases for handling structured and unstructured data.

Affiliate Systems: Experience with integrating or building affiliate tracking systems is a plus.

Security and Compliance: Understanding of best practices for app security and data compliance (GDPR).

Preferred Experience:

Experience with Superwall or other analytics and subscription management tools.

Previous experience in developing apps that involve price comparison or ecommerce.

Familiarity with app performance optimization, particularly caching strategies and background processing.

Project Scope:

The initial version of the app will focus on core functionalities like meal planning, recipe management, price comparison, and affiliate tracking. The app will be developed for iOS, with the potential to expand to Android in future iterations.

How to Apply:
Please provide:

A brief introduction outlining your experience in mobile app development.

Links to any relevant projects you’ve worked on.

Your approach to building scalable and efficient apps.

Availability and estimated time to complete the project.
jobs.ai_remark: Recommend Software Dev services for building a cross-platform mobile app using Flutter or React Native, Firebase/AWS backend, and real-time supermarket price scraping.

jobs.description:
Hello, 

I am having an automated tennis wagering platform developed that uses cloudbet.com and its api to aquire information about upcoming matches, and another website to then scrape player data from. After using the data to then generate picks from a program that I write and your program will call (the prediction is my portion of the project), your program will then place the wagers on cloudbet. You won't have access to the prediction code; instead you will need to make a small placeholder application to make pseudorandom predictions using the input and output formats which each program will be designed to parse.

Most of the program is complete. However it is in python and uses selenium for scraping; I wish to convert to C# and use HtmlAgilityPack instead. You will also need to fix any bugs and make a few changes to the program from its current flow. I can share the details by Upwork chat and zoom while interviewing.

I plan to offer $250 for the project.

jobs.description:
Expensify is a team of generalists developing today's leading expense management tool. Maintaining our reputation as an innovative leader in the world of finance requires an incredibly reliable and secure system for processing financial transactions. Accordingly, we primarily leverage time-tested languages, but we're looking to unify our front-end across platforms. For this, we're leveraging React Native and are looking toward the community on Upwork to help solve a variety of problems, both big and small, related to this migration.

Please see the GitHub issue for full details: github.com/Expensify/App/issues/67811

Your Proposal:

- You *must* post a proposal for how you will fix this issue in the GitHub issue linked above.
- Your proposal should include a technical explanation of the changes you will make. You are not required to submit the final solution or code along with your proposal.
- Your proposal will be reviewed.
- If your proposal is accepted, you should post the proposal in Upwork and you will be hired for the job.
- AFTER your proposal is accepted in Upwork and you have accepted the offer, you may submit the code to implement your solution. To submit the code, go to the Expensify/App GitHub repo where you'll create a fork of our codebase. You'll create a branch on that fork, and when your code is ready for review, you'll create a pull request in our repository to merge your code into our codebase. Include screenshots and confirmation that you have tested the pull request on all platforms. Our engineers will review the code, and approve and merge when the code meets our requirements.

Please review our Contributor Guidelines before submitting a proposal - github.com/Expensify/App/blob/main/contributingGuides/CONTRIBUTING.md

**Important:** As documented in our CONTRIBUTING.md, payment amounts are variable, dependent on any regressions your work causes.

jobs.title: C++ / Juce dev to design a synth/sequencer for proof of concept to potential hardware and plugin
jobs.description:
We are a startup designing a hardware synth and sequencer. In order to prove our workflow and design we want to begin work with a VST host or plugin that combines our proposed synth engine and sequencer on a desktop gui. We want as much code as possible to be transferrable to our target hardware and so C++ even with the Juce framework gives us a good deal of overlap for our non gui efforts. 

The project contains two parts: A synthesizer engine with various forms of sound generation as oscillators (specifically a hybrid FM / subtractive osc; a sample based/granular engine; basic multisample mapping; and physical modeling). For this scope we might agree to plan for a subset of the sound generators to reach mvp and then complete the other generation types once we have a working model. 

The sequencer for this software project will be a 4 track piano-roll style sequencer. In addition to the basic functionality implied, some novel concepts around playhead control and modulation will be added. The sequencer should be able to record modulation from MPE sources and the tracks, while primarily tied to the embedded synth engine, should be able to record and transmit midi. 

We are well-funded and have experience in successful startups, albeit not in digital audio design, but we are aware of the expected effort in this project and are most interested in working with passionate people who are excellent at sprint planning / milestone setting, and can help realize the vision. 

If the project is a great fit and there's mutual interest, there is opportunity for a longer-term hire beyond this project to bring the hardware to fruition and work on commercialization of the software.

This role is crucial in assisting us with building innovative new features, integrating various APIs, and upgrading our bespoke WordPress site to enhance user experience and functionality. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in WordPress development, showcasing not only technical expertise but also the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

As a WordPress Developer, your primary responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

1. **Feature Development:** Collaborate closely with our design and content teams to develop and implement new features that align with our overall vision and meet user needs. This will involve coding, debugging, and testing new functionalities to ensure a seamless experience for our visitors.

2. **API Integration:** Work on integrating third-party APIs to enhance the functionality of our site. You will be expected to understand the technical requirements of various integrations, troubleshoot issues as they arise, and ensure that all systems work harmoniously together.

3. **Site Upgrades:** Regularly assess and upgrade our custom WordPress site to keep up with the latest industry standards and best practices. This includes updating plugins, themes, and core WordPress files, as well as implementing security measures to protect our site and user data.

4. **Performance Optimization:** Monitor and optimize the performance of the website to ensure fast load times and an overall smooth user experience. You will be expected to conduct performance audits and apply necessary enhancements to improve site speed and responsiveness.

5. **Collaboration:** Engage with our team members to identify opportunities for enhancements and to brainstorm creative solutions to challenges that may arise. Your input will be valued in team meetings, and you will be encouraged to share your ideas for improving our processes and products.

6. **User Experience Focus:** Maintain a strong focus on user experience throughout the development process. This will involve understanding user behavior and preferences, as well as conducting tests to gather feedback and make data-driven decisions.

7. **Documentation and Reporting:** Document your development processes and update project statuses as needed. This will help ensure transparency within the team and enable effective communication regarding project timelines and deliverables.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successful WordPress development projects, with a portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities. Proficiency in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is essential, along with experience in popular page builders and themes. Familiarity with SEO best practices and website analytics tools will also be beneficial.

If you are passionate about creating user-friendly and efficient web solutions and have a keen eye for detail, we would love to hear from you! Join us in our mission to build exceptional web experiences that meet the needs of our users. Please submit your resume along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and projects. We look forward to the possibility of working together!
