jobs.title: WordPress Template Build Brief - cashloansexpress.com Website
jobs.description:
Project Overview: Dogstar Digital Group requires a new WordPress website template developed based on provided Figma designs for our key brand, cashloansexpress.com. The primary goal is to translate these designs into a highly flexible, reusable, and easily editable WordPress theme using the Breakdance page builder. This website will operate exclusively in the USA. Its core purpose is to increase organic search rankings for our content, though we anticipate customers may find our lead forms through this SEO-focused site. Please note that our paid traffic for lead distribution is directed to the loans. subdomain, not this website. This site is heavily SEO-focused, so clean code and performance are paramount.
Key Requirements:

1. Platform: WordPress, on the root domain cashloansexpress.com.
2. Page Builder: Breakdance (https://breakdance.com/)
- The template MUST be built entirely within the Breakdance environment.
- Leverage Breakdance's theme builder capabilities for headers, footers, and page templates.
- Prioritize the creation of re-usable "Global Blocks" or Breakdance sections/elements wherever possible to facilitate easy content updates and consistency across the site.

3. Design Source: Figma designs located at:
https://www.figma.com/design/1cKjFINtoB8JCFQkSB7S1y/CLE-SEO-Website?node-id=12-429&p=f&t=QsE7todAw1eUwUtJ-0
- All visual aspects (typography, colors, spacing, imagery placeholders, etc.) should precisely match the Figma designs across all specified breakpoints (desktop, mobile).
Important: Please refer to the comments within the Figma designs for specific notes on interactivity, animations, and carousel behaviors.
- Any responsive behaviors not explicitly defined in Figma should be implemented intuitively and consistently, favoring common web design best practices (e.g., stacked elements on mobile, legible text sizes).

Template Scope: Develop the following page templates/structures within Breakdance:
-Home Page (/): A unique, fully developed template matching the Figma home page design.
-Articles Parent Page (/blogs): A template to display a list of articles, likely utilizing Breakdance's Post Loop Builder. This should include pagination if the design implies it or a common blog archive structure.
-Single Article Template (/blogs/example-article): A consistent template for all individual article posts. This should dynamically pull in article content (title, featured image, body, author, date, categories/tags).
-Loan Type Template (/loan-type/payday-loans): This template will serve as a foundational structure for multiple "loan type" pages (e.g., /loan-type/bad-credit-loans, /loan-type/emergency-cash-loans). The structure of this template will remain static, but all text and image content within it must be easily modifiable for each specific loan type page. This will likely involve using Breakdance's dynamic data features and/or custom fields (e.g., ACF or Meta Box) for seamless content management.
-Loans Near Me Template (/loans-near-me/california-instant-cash-loans): Will be the template on the ‘Loans By City’ tab in figma.
-Loan Type Parent Page Template (/loan-type/):
-Loans Near Me Parent Page Template (/loans-near-me):
FAQs Page (/faqs): A template for the Frequently Asked Questions page. Consider using Breakdance's accordion or toggle elements for each FAQ item to enhance user experience.
-About Us Page (/about-us): A standard static page template for the About Us content.

5. Reusability & Modularity:
-A core objective is to maximize reusability. Identify any repeating sections, elements, or "blocks" within the designs (e.g., hero sections, testimonial blocks, call-to-action sections, feature lists, headers, footers) and build them as Breakdance Global Blocks or Reusable Templates. This will empower our content team to easily build new pages or modify existing ones without requiring developer intervention.
-Specifically for the "loan-type" template, ensure that all dynamic content (text, images) is easily editable via the WordPress admin, without allowing for structural changes on a per-page basis.

6. Content Management Experience:
-The resulting templates should provide a "much nicer editing experience" for our SEO team, as per their feedback on Breakdance. This means clear labeling of sections and elements within the Breakdance editor, logical grouping, and intuitive controls for content changes.
-Avoid hard-coding content within the templates where it should be editable by non-developers.

7. SEO & Performance Considerations:
-Ensure the generated HTML is clean, semantic, and highly SEO-friendly. This includes proper heading structure (H1, H2, etc.) as indicated in designs or as appropriate for SEO best practices.
-Breakdance is known for performance; ensure best practices are followed to maintain fast loading times, considering image optimization, efficient asset loading, and minimal render-blocking resources.
-The site is for cashloansexpress.com and has a primary focus on increasing organic search rankings for content. Adherence to web vitals and overall site performance is crucial for SEO success.

8. Technical Details & Hosting Environment:
-Please confirm your familiarity and experience with Breakdance builder.
-Outline your proposed approach to structuring the Breakdance templates (e.g., custom post types, global elements, specific template types for archives/singles).
-Provide an estimated timeline for the development of these templates.
-Detail your process for handling revisions and ensuring design fidelity.
-Hosting Environment: The website will be hosted on a Linux VM. If there are any questions regarding specific services (e.g., caching mechanisms like Memcached or Redis), please inquire. Generally, if a service can run on Linux and does not incur significant licensing fees, we can likely support its implementation.

Clarifying Questions to the Builder:
-Do you have a Breakdance Pro license, or will we need to provide one?
-What is your standard workflow for design handoff and ensuring pixel-perfect implementation with Figma, especially considering the embedded comments for interactivity?
Given the "loan-type" template's static structure but dynamic text/image content, how do you plan to implement this in -Breakdance for easy content editing (e.g., using specific custom fields with ACF/Meta Box, or Breakdance's built-in dynamic content features)?
-Can you provide examples of other WordPress sites you've built using Breakdance, particularly those with a focus on reusable components and SEO?
What is your approach to ensuring cross-browser compatibility and responsiveness across all devices?

jobs.title: Capacitor v7 Plugin Developer for a Receipt Scanner (iOS & Android)
jobs.description:
Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced Capacitor plugin developer to create a high-quality, custom Capacitor v7 plugin for scanning printed receipts. The goal is to provide a seamless, "scan-and-go" user experience similar to the document scanner found in the iOS Notes app.
The plugin must be robust, performant, and work flawlessly on both iOS and Android platforms. You will be responsible for the entire plugin development lifecycle, from initial setup to final documentation and delivery.

Detailed Project Description & Core Functionality
The core task is to build a Capacitor plugin that, when invoked from our application's JavaScript code, performs the following actions:
1.	Initiate Camera View: The plugin must open a dedicated camera view.
2.	Live Document Detection: It must actively scan the camera feed to detect a rectangular shape, such as a piece of paper (the receipt).
3.	Visual Feedback: As the paper is detected, its borders must be highlighted with an overlay on the camera view. This provides real-time feedback to the user, guiding them to position the receipt correctly.
4.	Automatic Capture: The plugin should automatically take a picture without requiring a manual button press from the user. The auto-capture should be triggered ONLY when the following conditions are met:
o	The entire receipt is within the camera's view.
o	The image is stable and of good quality (not blurry).
5.	Single Page Limit: The scanning process is limited to a single page/photo. Once the photo is captured, the camera view should close.
6.	Image Processing: After capturing the image, the plugin must perform perspective correction and crop the image to the detected borders of the receipt. The final result should be a clean, flat image of just the receipt itself.
7.	Return Value: The final, cropped image must be returned to the Capacitor web view as a dataURI string.

Technical Requirements:
•	Framework: The plugin must be built for Capacitor v7 with Typescript support.
•	Platform Support: Must be fully functional on both iOS and Android.
•	User Experience: While the underlying native implementation can differ, the final user experience on both platforms must satisfy all functional requirements.
•	Image Output:
o	The final image should be a standard format, preferably JPEG.
o	The return type from the plugin's method must be a dataURI.
o	We would prefer the ability to specify a maximum resolution or quality for the output image as a parameter to the plugin method (e.g., scanReceipt ( maxWidth: 1024 )).


Development & Delivery Requirements:
•	Third-Party SDKs: You are free to use any third-party libraries or SDKs, provided they are free for commercial use and their licenses are compatible with our project. Please document any such dependencies.
•	Code Repository: You must commit and push all source code to a private GitHub repository that we will provide access to.
•	Ownership: Upon completion and final payment, you agree to transfer the full and exclusive ownership of the plugin, all source code, and related assets to us.
•	Documentation: You must provide clear and comprehensive documentation (README.md in the repository) that includes:
o	Installation and setup instructions.
o	API reference for the plugin's methods.
o	Simple, practical examples of how to use the plugin in a TypeScript environment.

Payment Terms
This is a fixed-price contract. The full payment will be released from escrow only after the following conditions are met:
1.	The complete project is delivered and pushed to our GitHub repository.
2.	All requirements listed in this job post have been satisfied.
3.	The required documentation has been provided.
Note: Any potential deviation from these requirements due to technical limitations must be discussed with and approved by us in writing before the contract begins.

jobs.title: Experienced React Native Developer Needed for Children's Music App MVP
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented and experienced React Native developer to build the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for a new music streaming application designed specifically for daycare centers. The app will provide a simple, reliable, and curated music experience for children and staff.
You can see the UI design for the MVP in the attached image.

MVP SCOPE & CORE FEATURES:

1. Music Player & Navigation

 * Standard player controls: Play, Pause, Previous, and Next.
 * Shuffle mode for playlists.
 * A home screen to browse primary categories (e.g., "Transition," "Themes," "White Noise," "Favorites").
 * Ability to view and play songs within a selected category.

2. Offline-First Functionality

 * The app must be fully functional without an internet connection.
 * Implement a smart caching strategy: when a song is played online, it must be downloaded and stored locally.
 * Use a fixed amount of local storage. When storage is full, automatically delete the least recently played song to make space (LRU cache).

3. Search Functionality

 * Implement search to find tracks by title, tag, description, or lyrics.

4. System Integration

 * Audio must continue playing seamlessly in the background.
 * Integrate native lock screen media controls (track info, play/pause, previous/next).
 * Support standard Bluetooth controls from external devices (e.g., speakers).

5. Internal Analytics & Feedback

 * Track basic playback stats for each song (e.g., play count). Queue and send to backend when online.
 * Include a simple "Contact & Feedback" button (e.g., opens a pre-filled email).

NO USER LOGIN:

No user login system is required for this MVP.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

* Technology: React Native
* Platforms: iOS and Android
* Offline Storage: Experience with robust local storage for audio files and metadata (e.g., react-native-fs, MMKV, WatermelonDB).
* Audio Playback: Proficient with a reliable background audio/system controls library (e.g., react-native-track-player).

BACKEND & API:

We have an existing backend that provides all necessary data.

* Headless CMS: Directus (songs, playlists, metadata)
* Database & API: Supabase (PostgreSQL) with a ready-to-use GraphQL API for song lists, search results, etc.
* Audio Hosting: Backblaze B2; API provides direct URLs for streaming and downloading.
 Note: You should be able to build the MVP with the current backend; any missing tables/fields can be added via the Directus UI.

BONUS POINTS (HIGHLY VALUED):

* Experience setting up a monorepo for code sharing between the React Native app and a future Next.js web app.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

* A freelance developer with a strong portfolio of high-quality React Native apps.
* Experience building audio streaming apps, especially background audio and offline caching.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to propose/implement robust offline architecture.
* Clear communication and a proactive work ethic.

FUTURE WORK:

This MVP is the first stage of a larger project. If the launch is successful, we have a roadmap of new features and enhancements. We are looking for a developer interested in long-term collaboration to help grow the platform.

We are excited to hear from you and build something great together!

jobs.title: C++ / Juce dev to design a synth/sequencer for proof of concept to potential hardware and plugin
jobs.description:
We are a startup designing a hardware synth and sequencer. In order to prove our workflow and design we want to begin work with a VST host or plugin that combines our proposed synth engine and sequencer on a desktop gui. We want as much code as possible to be transferrable to our target hardware and so C++ even with the Juce framework gives us a good deal of overlap for our non gui efforts. 

The project contains two parts: A synthesizer engine with various forms of sound generation as oscillators (specifically a hybrid FM / subtractive osc; a sample based/granular engine; basic multisample mapping; and physical modeling). For this scope we might agree to plan for a subset of the sound generators to reach mvp and then complete the other generation types once we have a working model. 

The sequencer for this software project will be a 4 track piano-roll style sequencer. In addition to the basic functionality implied, some novel concepts around playhead control and modulation will be added. The sequencer should be able to record modulation from MPE sources and the tracks, while primarily tied to the embedded synth engine, should be able to record and transmit midi. 

We are well-funded and have experience in successful startups, albeit not in digital audio design, but we are aware of the expected effort in this project and are most interested in working with passionate people who are excellent at sprint planning / milestone setting, and can help realize the vision. 

If the project is a great fit and there's mutual interest, there is opportunity for a longer-term hire beyond this project to bring the hardware to fruition and work on commercialization of the software.

jobs.title: WordPress Template Build Brief - cashloansexpress.com Website
jobs.description:
Project Overview: Dogstar Digital Group requires a new WordPress website template developed based on provided Figma designs for our key brand, cashloansexpress.com. The primary goal is to translate these designs into a highly flexible, reusable, and easily editable WordPress theme using the Breakdance page builder. This website will operate exclusively in the USA. Its core purpose is to increase organic search rankings for our content, though we anticipate customers may find our lead forms through this SEO-focused site. Please note that our paid traffic for lead distribution is directed to the loans. subdomain, not this website. This site is heavily SEO-focused, so clean code and performance are paramount.
Key Requirements:

1. Platform: WordPress, on the root domain cashloansexpress.com.
2. Page Builder: Breakdance (https://breakdance.com/)
- The template MUST be built entirely within the Breakdance environment.
- Leverage Breakdance's theme builder capabilities for headers, footers, and page templates.
- Prioritize the creation of re-usable "Global Blocks" or Breakdance sections/elements wherever possible to facilitate easy content updates and consistency across the site.

3. Design Source: Figma designs located at:
https://www.figma.com/design/1cKjFINtoB8JCFQkSB7S1y/CLE-SEO-Website?node-id=12-429&p=f&t=QsE7todAw1eUwUtJ-0
- All visual aspects (typography, colors, spacing, imagery placeholders, etc.) should precisely match the Figma designs across all specified breakpoints (desktop, mobile).
Important: Please refer to the comments within the Figma designs for specific notes on interactivity, animations, and carousel behaviors.
- Any responsive behaviors not explicitly defined in Figma should be implemented intuitively and consistently, favoring common web design best practices (e.g., stacked elements on mobile, legible text sizes).

Template Scope: Develop the following page templates/structures within Breakdance:
-Home Page (/): A unique, fully developed template matching the Figma home page design.
-Articles Parent Page (/blogs): A template to display a list of articles, likely utilizing Breakdance's Post Loop Builder. This should include pagination if the design implies it or a common blog archive structure.
-Single Article Template (/blogs/example-article): A consistent template for all individual article posts. This should dynamically pull in article content (title, featured image, body, author, date, categories/tags).
-Loan Type Template (/loan-type/payday-loans): This template will serve as a foundational structure for multiple "loan type" pages (e.g., /loan-type/bad-credit-loans, /loan-type/emergency-cash-loans). The structure of this template will remain static, but all text and image content within it must be easily modifiable for each specific loan type page. This will likely involve using Breakdance's dynamic data features and/or custom fields (e.g., ACF or Meta Box) for seamless content management.
-Loans Near Me Template (/loans-near-me/california-instant-cash-loans): Will be the template on the ‘Loans By City’ tab in figma.
-Loan Type Parent Page Template (/loan-type/):
-Loans Near Me Parent Page Template (/loans-near-me):
FAQs Page (/faqs): A template for the Frequently Asked Questions page. Consider using Breakdance's accordion or toggle elements for each FAQ item to enhance user experience.
-About Us Page (/about-us): A standard static page template for the About Us content.

5. Reusability & Modularity:
-A core objective is to maximize reusability. Identify any repeating sections, elements, or "blocks" within the designs (e.g., hero sections, testimonial blocks, call-to-action sections, feature lists, headers, footers) and build them as Breakdance Global Blocks or Reusable Templates. This will empower our content team to easily build new pages or modify existing ones without requiring developer intervention.
-Specifically for the "loan-type" template, ensure that all dynamic content (text, images) is easily editable via the WordPress admin, without allowing for structural changes on a per-page basis.

6. Content Management Experience:
-The resulting templates should provide a "much nicer editing experience" for our SEO team, as per their feedback on Breakdance. This means clear labeling of sections and elements within the Breakdance editor, logical grouping, and intuitive controls for content changes.
-Avoid hard-coding content within the templates where it should be editable by non-developers.

7. SEO & Performance Considerations:
-Ensure the generated HTML is clean, semantic, and highly SEO-friendly. This includes proper heading structure (H1, H2, etc.) as indicated in designs or as appropriate for SEO best practices.
-Breakdance is known for performance; ensure best practices are followed to maintain fast loading times, considering image optimization, efficient asset loading, and minimal render-blocking resources.
-The site is for cashloansexpress.com and has a primary focus on increasing organic search rankings for content. Adherence to web vitals and overall site performance is crucial for SEO success.

8. Technical Details & Hosting Environment:
-Please confirm your familiarity and experience with Breakdance builder.
-Outline your proposed approach to structuring the Breakdance templates (e.g., custom post types, global elements, specific template types for archives/singles).
-Provide an estimated timeline for the development of these templates.
-Detail your process for handling revisions and ensuring design fidelity.
-Hosting Environment: The website will be hosted on a Linux VM. If there are any questions regarding specific services (e.g., caching mechanisms like Memcached or Redis), please inquire. Generally, if a service can run on Linux and does not incur significant licensing fees, we can likely support its implementation.

Clarifying Questions to the Builder:
-Do you have a Breakdance Pro license, or will we need to provide one?
-What is your standard workflow for design handoff and ensuring pixel-perfect implementation with Figma, especially considering the embedded comments for interactivity?
Given the "loan-type" template's static structure but dynamic text/image content, how do you plan to implement this in -Breakdance for easy content editing (e.g., using specific custom fields with ACF/Meta Box, or Breakdance's built-in dynamic content features)?
-Can you provide examples of other WordPress sites you've built using Breakdance, particularly those with a focus on reusable components and SEO?
What is your approach to ensuring cross-browser compatibility and responsiveness across all devices?

We are not looking for someone who only codes line-by-line.

### 🧪 Test Before Trust – Mandatory First Challenge (Unpaid)

Before any discussion or contract, you’ll need to prove your ability to use Lovable and Supabase with prompt-based logic.

❗️ We do not schedule calls or meetings before this test is submitted – to respect everyone’s time.

#### 🔧 Unpaid Test Task (Lovable + Supabase):

- Goal: Show that you can build a small web interface using Lovable with smart prompting and basic Supabase auth.
 
- Task:
 
 - Create a login page (basic, email + password).
 
 - When login is successful, show a minimal admin interface that displays:
 
 “I know how to use Lovable efficiently for website creation, this test project doesn't scare me.”
 
 - Use Supabase for authentication (you must give us 1 email + 1 password to test the login).

🕐 This should take less than 10 minutes with effective Lovable usage.

❌ If this seems too hard or time-consuming, this collaboration is not a good fit.

✅ If the test is accepted:

“If you pass this first test, a paid test mission with more support will follow to evaluate your ability to grow with us.”

---

### 💰 Paid Test Mission (Post-Test)

You will receive access to a small site already hosted on Lovable and a list of ~20 very light changes to apply. 
These include things like:

- Modifying or replacing text (in French)
 
- Deleting unnecessary pages
 
- Slight design edits
 

The goal: evaluate your speed, logic, and mastery of Lovable when editing an existing website — as well as your ability to follow simple instructions written in French.

### 📌 Main Mission (After Paid Test)

You will be assigned 3 small showcase sites (less than 10 pages each) to clone:

- 2 sites built on Framer
 
- 1 site built on Webflow (already partially cloned, needs dynamic database linking)
 

All sites are owned by us. Your job will be to reproduce them pixel-perfect, clean and fast.

jobs.title: Capacitor v7 Plugin Developer for a Receipt Scanner (iOS & Android)
jobs.description:
Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced Capacitor plugin developer to create a high-quality, custom Capacitor v7 plugin for scanning printed receipts. The goal is to provide a seamless, "scan-and-go" user experience similar to the document scanner found in the iOS Notes app.
The plugin must be robust, performant, and work flawlessly on both iOS and Android platforms. You will be responsible for the entire plugin development lifecycle, from initial setup to final documentation and delivery.

Detailed Project Description & Core Functionality
The core task is to build a Capacitor plugin that, when invoked from our application's JavaScript code, performs the following actions:
1.	Initiate Camera View: The plugin must open a dedicated camera view.
2.	Live Document Detection: It must actively scan the camera feed to detect a rectangular shape, such as a piece of paper (the receipt).
3.	Visual Feedback: As the paper is detected, its borders must be highlighted with an overlay on the camera view. This provides real-time feedback to the user, guiding them to position the receipt correctly.
4.	Automatic Capture: The plugin should automatically take a picture without requiring a manual button press from the user. The auto-capture should be triggered ONLY when the following conditions are met:
o	The entire receipt is within the camera's view.
o	The image is stable and of good quality (not blurry).
5.	Single Page Limit: The scanning process is limited to a single page/photo. Once the photo is captured, the camera view should close.
6.	Image Processing: After capturing the image, the plugin must perform perspective correction and crop the image to the detected borders of the receipt. The final result should be a clean, flat image of just the receipt itself.
7.	Return Value: The final, cropped image must be returned to the Capacitor web view as a dataURI string.

Technical Requirements:
•	Framework: The plugin must be built for Capacitor v7 with Typescript support.
•	Platform Support: Must be fully functional on both iOS and Android.
•	User Experience: While the underlying native implementation can differ, the final user experience on both platforms must satisfy all functional requirements.
•	Image Output:
o	The final image should be a standard format, preferably JPEG.
o	The return type from the plugin's method must be a dataURI.
o	We would prefer the ability to specify a maximum resolution or quality for the output image as a parameter to the plugin method (e.g., scanReceipt ( maxWidth: 1024 )).


Development & Delivery Requirements:
•	Third-Party SDKs: You are free to use any third-party libraries or SDKs, provided they are free for commercial use and their licenses are compatible with our project. Please document any such dependencies.
•	Code Repository: You must commit and push all source code to a private GitHub repository that we will provide access to.
•	Ownership: Upon completion and final payment, you agree to transfer the full and exclusive ownership of the plugin, all source code, and related assets to us.
•	Documentation: You must provide clear and comprehensive documentation (README.md in the repository) that includes:
o	Installation and setup instructions.
o	API reference for the plugin's methods.
o	Simple, practical examples of how to use the plugin in a TypeScript environment.

Payment Terms
This is a fixed-price contract. The full payment will be released from escrow only after the following conditions are met:
1.	The complete project is delivered and pushed to our GitHub repository.
2.	All requirements listed in this job post have been satisfied.
3.	The required documentation has been provided.
Note: Any potential deviation from these requirements due to technical limitations must be discussed with and approved by us in writing before the contract begins.

jobs.title: Build a Custom Google Sheets-Based Business Directory (No Backend, Wix Site)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a developer to build a simple, responsive, searchable directory to replace our current embedded Awesome Table setup. The data lives in a Google Sheet and powers a set of card-style listings on our Wix website.

This project is for a public-facing Black-Owned Business Directory hosted at blackeverywhere.org, and should be built using client-side HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only (no backend). You'll deliver a code bundle that we can embed via a Wix custom HTML block. We’d like to meet on video at the end to walk through placing the code into our Wix site together.

The source of truth is a Google Sheet, which includes two tabs: one for raw data (auto-populated from a Wix form) and one for the card template. The sheet has an onChange script that removes duplicates and handles basic formatting.

The frontend should display a responsive card layout that includes business name, city, owner name, category, and contact info. If the business is marked as Featured, the card should also display a description and an optional image. Featured cards should be styled with background color #fff0d6 and border #ff9900. The image should appear at the bottom of the card and be blank if not provided. Only Featured listings include a description and image.

We need two filters: a fixed dropdown for City and a fixed dropdown for Category. These do not need to be dynamically generated. An optional search box that supports partial matches would be great but not required.

Use the Google Sheets API to pull and render data. Cards should automatically reflect any updates made in the sheet. No login is required to view the directory. The final deliverable should be clean, responsive, and match the overall look and feel of our site. Brand color #ffdc07 is optional and can be used for highlights.

We’d love a toggle to show only Featured listings and a simple hover or fade-in animation for the cards.

You’ll deliver a single HTML/CSS/JS bundle that we can paste into our Wix site using an embed block. We’d like one short video call at the end where we can screen share and add the embed together.

Proven experience with WordPress, WooCommerce, and PHP.

jobs.title: Build a Personal Expense Tracker
jobs.description:
The Personal Expense Tracker will be a simple web application aimed at helping users track their income and expenses. The goal is to allow users to add, update, delete, and view financial transactions categorized by type (income or expense) and organized into categories like Food, Rent, Utilities, etc. 

Users should also be able to view a monthly summary that calculates total income, total expenses, and savings (income minus expenses) for a given period. The backend will be built using Spring Boot and expose a set of RESTful APIs to handle all operations related to transactions and categories. 

Persistence will be handled using Spring Data JPA with either an H2 in-memory database for development or MySQL for production.

The frontend can be built using either Thymeleaf for a simple server-rendered UI or React for a more dynamic client-side experience. 

Optional JWT-based authentication can be implemented to support user-specific data and secure API access, but for the MVP, a single-user mode without authentication is acceptable. The main deliverables are working CRUD endpoints for transactions and categories, a basic frontend to interact with those APIs, and a monthly report generator that summarizes financial activity.

jobs.title: Webpack Code Refactoring
jobs.description:
I'm seeking an experienced JavaScript developer with expertise in Webpack, code bundling, deobfuscation, and refactoring to help untangle a complex, minified, obfuscated JS bundle from a standalone web app.

This is basically the 1st phase of a larger refactoring project.
Our goal is to untangle these components into a readable and organized file structure.

There is a single js file which needs to be worked. It contains:
1.Webpack Runtime: Bootstrap code that manages and loads modules.
2.Hot Module Replacement (HMR) Code: Logic for live-reloading during development, which is not needed in a static deployment.
3.Third-Party Libraries: Full source code for libraries like decimal.js, Math.js, Bunyan, bowser.js, ....
4.Application Code: The core logic for your cognitive tasks.


Here is what I am expecting to be done:

Step 1- Project Restructuring and Preparation
Goal: Create a clean project structure and make the bundled code readable.

In project's /js/ directory, create two new subdirectories:
- js/libs/: This will hold the standalone third-party library files.
- js/app/: This will hold the refactored application code.


Step 2- Remove the Hot Module Replacement (HMR) code.
Goal: Strip out the development-only HMR code from the application bundle.


Step 3- Externalizing Third-Party Libraries
Goal: Replace the bundled library code with links to standalone files. 
This will require sourcing the original versions online and replacing the current code with those.


Step 4: Isolating Application Logic from Runtime
Goal: Separate the Webpack runtime from the application modules to make the core logic easier to manage.

- Create js/app/runtime.js
move Webpack runtime from the original js into this new file.

- Create js/app/modules.js
Move the entire module array from the original js into this file.

- Delete the original js from project. It is not needed anymore.


Step 5- Code Readability and Deobfuscation
Goal: Transform the cryptic, minified application code within js/app/modules.js into human-readable, self-documenting code by renaming variables, functions, and replacing "magic numbers" with named constants.
(suggested approach: consider creating and using a Constants File, Rename Core Module Parameters and then systematically analyze modules to give variables and functions meaningful names and replace magic numbers/strings from the constants file).


Step 6- Update Files
Goal: Update all js and HTML files to use the new, refactored script structure.


Step 7- Check things in working shape
Goal: Run and play all tests, get results and examine working behavior in detail. Make sure there are no errors and everything delivered in working condition just like the original package.


Please do not apply if you don't have experience doing such thing. This is not a simple task but requires systematic approach, planning and experience.
Files available upon request.

Our client is a European engineering-recruitment agency. They want to automate candidate-inbox triage and the initial phone-screening process using AI and Odoo.

Email → Odoo workflow – IMAP listener → GPT-4 classification → EU work-permit filter → create candidate record with attachments & AI tags in Odoo.

Voice bot – Odoo webhook → Telnyx Voice + Retell AI French → transcription + AI summary → attach to candidate record in Odoo.

Manual Call Flow – Ingest recording -MP3/WAV- → transcription + summary → update Odoo.

Tests & Docs 80 % Jest/Playwright coverage, README and Mermaid diagrams.

Go-Live & Support – Deployment on VPS, team training, 30-day bug-fix support.

n8n, Node.js / TypeScript, Odoo API, GPT-4 , Telnyx Voice API + Retell AI, Docker, GitHub Actions, GDPR best practices.

Relevant experience -max 200 words-.

jobs.title: Build Mobile ARV Calculator • React + Zillow Scraper + Google Maps
jobs.description:
I need a streamlined, responsive web app that estimates After-Repair Value (ARV) for residential properties. The tool pulls comparable sales from Zillow (or another compliant source), runs valuation analytics (median/weighted, linear regression), and lets users interactively refine the comp set.

Architecture: Single “monolith” web app (no separate API layer yet) 
Branding: We’ll supply a style guide (colors, fonts, logo) after kickoff

Core Requirements:

Input Form:
• Property address or Zillow URL (user chooses)
• Radius (mi, default 1.0)
• Living-Area Band (± % of subject SF, default 10 %)
• Beds/Baths (± 1 allowed)
• Sold-Within Window (6 / 12 / 24 months; actives have no age limit)
• Rehab Budget ($) – optional

Data Retrieval:
• Pull subject details + nearby SOLD and ACTIVE comps that meet filters
• Use Apify Zillow actors (preferred) or suggest a TOS-compliant alternative

Computation:
• Calculate price / SF per comp• Remove outliers via IQR rule (Q1–1.5 × IQR, Q3+1.5 × IQR)
• Show Median and Weighted $/SF ARV
• Linear regression (OLS) on Living Area → Price using SOLD comps → display equation, R², and Regression-based ARV
• Budget check: let the user set a “Budget-to-Uplift” threshold (e.g., 50 %–90 %). If the entered Rehab Budget falls below that user-defined percentage of the implied uplift, display a warning.

Visual Output:
• Google Maps (subject pin, SOLD comps = solid, ACTIVE comps = hollow)
• Scatter Plot #1 – Price vs Living Area (includes regression trend line + optional confidence band)
• Scatter Plot #2 – Price/SF vs Living Area
• Comps Table – sortable, copy/export CSV

Interactive Controls:
• Include/Exclude checkbox per comp (charts & metrics update instantly)
• Add Comp button: user enters address or Zillow URL → app scrapes & adds to set

Property Types: 

• All available property types on Zillow

Tech & UX
• Modern front-end (React + Tailwind suggested, but open) mobile-first
• Mapping: Google Maps JS -- required
• Charting: Google Charts or Recharts (your pick)• Configurable API keys via env vars
• Deploy anywhere (AWS, Vercel, Render, etc.) — no preference

Phase Limits: 
• No auth or DB persistence in v1 (future phase)• Write code so storage layer can be added later

Desired Skill Set
* React, Vue, Svelte, or similar + responsive design
* Node/Express, Next.js API routes, or Python Flask for back-end logic
* Web-scraping (Apify, Puppeteer, Scrapy, or alt) & API integration
* Google Maps JS & charting libraries
* Clean Git workflow, clear docs, and basic tests

Deliverables
1. Full source code in a private Git repo
2. README: setup, env-vars, deploy steps
3. Live demo URL or Docker image we can run locally

Please include:
1. Tech stack & architecture you’ll use (and why)
2. Scraping strategy (Apify or alternative) & TOS compliance approach
3. Links to 2-3 projects showcasing similar skills (scraping, real-estate, mapping, data viz)
4. Estimate of hours to complete project. Feel free to provide a fixed-price fee.

We are looking for a skilled developer to integrate Google and Microsoft social logins into our existing web application. Our stack is React, TypeScript, and Firebase, and we already have a functioning email/password authentication system in place.

The goal is to enhance our user experience by offering seamless sign-in and registration options through popular social providers.

## Project Scope & Requirements

Your primary task will be to implement the authentication flow for Google and Microsoft accounts. The desired user flow is as follows:

User Initiates Social Login: The user clicks a "Sign in with Google" or "Sign in with Microsoft" button on our login page.

Check for Existing User:

If the user's email already exists in our Firebase Authentication system, they should be logged in immediately and redirected to their dashboard.

If the user is new, they must be redirected to our existing registration page.

Pre-fill Registration Form: For new users, the registration form must be automatically pre-filled with the information retrieved from their social profile (e.g., full name, email address). The user can then complete any remaining fields and finalize their account creation.

## Required Skills

Expert Proficiency in React & TypeScript: You must be able to write clean, maintainable, and type-safe code within our existing codebase.

Strong Experience with Firebase: Deep knowledge of Firebase Authentication is essential, specifically with implementing social providers like GoogleAuthProvider and OAuthProvider for Microsoft.

Understanding of OAuth: You should be comfortable with the OAuth 2.0 flow and handling API responses from Google and Microsoft.

Attention to Detail: The implementation must be robust, secure, and provide a smooth user experience, including proper error handling.

We look forward to collaborating with you!

jobs.title: WooCommerce Expert Needed to Resolve URL Parameter Issues & SEO Crawl Problems
jobs.description:
We need a WooCommerce Expert to fix unwanted URL parameter generation & SEO crawl issues. 

The problem
Our WooCommerce site is experiencing a critical issue with the unintended generation of numerous (in thousands) URLs containing parameters like ?orderby=price, ?add-to-cart=730661, ?style=1&noamp=mobile&add-to-cart=730509, ?add_to_wishlist=14236, and others. Screenshot of the URLs: https://prnt.sc/hTDw3-2dNOFd 
The majority of these are directly related to WooCommerce functionalities. For instance, a valid page is being duplicated with these extra strings. Google is actively crawling these unauthorized URLs, which is severely impacting our crawl budget and overall site performance. 

What we've already tried so far (and didn't work)
We have already taken significant steps to address this problem. We updated our robots.txt file to block these parameter-based URLs, but Google continues to crawl them. We also implemented filters and functions provided by Rank Math SEO support, yet none of these solutions have stopped the persistent crawling. This confirms the issue is rooted in a deeper, more technical aspect of our site's configuration.

What we need from you (the solution)
We are looking for an expert developer to provide a definitive solution. Your responsibilities will be to:
(a) Investigate and diagnose the root cause of these unauthorized URL generations by thoroughly auditing our theme, plugins, and server environment.
(b) Implement a permanent fix that prevents these URLs from being created in the first place.
(c) Verify the solution ensures Google no longer crawls or indexes these specific URL patterns.

Required Skills
(1) Expertise in WordPress & WooCommerce: Extensive knowledge of the core architecture and functionality of both WordPress and WooCommerce.
(2) Advanced PHP Proficiency: Proven ability to develop and troubleshoot complex plugins, themes, and functionalities.
(3) SEO & Performance Knowledge: A strong understanding of how URL structures, crawl budget, and other technical factors impact site performance and search engine optimization.

Hosting & Technical Details
Our website is hosted on Pressable, which uses a custom control panel instead of cPanel. For your investigation and work, we'll grant you access to the following:
Database: Access via phpMyAdmin.
Filesystem: Access via SFTP or a file manager plugin.
Command Line: SSH access is available for those who prefer it. 

Additional Information
For a comprehensive understanding of the issue, please review the attached screenshot. We require a candidate with a proven track record who can deliver a lasting solution to this technical challenge.

jobs.title: Zero-Trust Encrypted File Sharing Platform Development
jobs.description:
I’m looking to build a proof of concept for a privacy-focused file sharing platform. My goal is to enter the secure file hosting space with a zero-trust, encryption-first product. I need someone to build the entire system from scratch, including the frontend, backend, and client-side encryption logic.

The platform must be fast, secure, and built around zero-trust principles. I have a strict timeline, a limited budget, and need someone who can start immediately.

I’m fine with quick, iterative development early on ("vibe coding"), but I will carefully review the code before releasing final payment. You must follow clean code practices. You can use open-source code as long as you clearly label it with a link to the source in the codebase.
✅ Core Requirements
1. Authentication

 Email + password login

 Passwords never stored in plaintext

 Derive a symmetric key client-side using PBKDF2, Argon2id, or scrypt

2. Client-Side Encryption

 AES-GCM for encrypting files in the browser before upload

 Per-file random encryption key

 Key is appended to the download URL as a fragment (#key=...)

 Backend never receives keys or decrypted content

3. Upload + Share

 Encrypt file and metadata client-side

 Upload encrypted file + encrypted metadata

 Server returns a short file ID

 Frontend appends key in fragment to create final link (e.g. https://domain.com/f/abc123#key=xyz456)

4. User Dashboard

 Users can:

 Log in

 View a list of their uploaded files

 Delete files

 Copy/share download links

 File list is stored encrypted with the user’s password-derived key

 Decryption of the file list happens only client-side

5. Backend API

 Stateless and minimal

 Handles:

 File upload and deletion

 Storage and retrieval of encrypted metadata and file index

💻 Preferred Stack

 Frontend: Next.js (TypeScript)

 Backend: Java (Spring Boot), Go, or Rust

 Database: Up to you (PostgreSQL, SQLite, or anything fast and minimal)

🛠 Optional / Bonus Features

 File expiry (after X days or downloads)

 Password recovery using an encrypted recovery key

 Encrypted audit logs (logins, deletes)

 File index export or backup (encrypted)

 Admin dashboard with no access to user data

 Dockerized setup

 Layered, clean architecture

📦 Deliverables

 Working proof of concept with:

 Login

 Upload

 Sharing

 File management

 Full source code (clean, documented)

 Setup instructions

 Documentation:

 Encryption model

 API structure

 Threat model

🧠 What You Need

 Strong background in encryption (AES-GCM, PBKDF2, Web Crypto)

 Full-stack experience

 Understanding of zero-trust design and E2EE

 Able to work fast and deliver clean, secure code

When Applying

 Preferred backend language and why

 Your pricing (note: small budget)

We are looking for an experienced Odoo 10 Community developer with a solid background in accounting and reporting to help restructure our ledger and implement new, accurate financial reports with a user-friendly interface.

- Trial Balance
- Income Statement
- Balance Sheet
- A clean, accessible interface must be developed to allow users to easily request each report using date range, fiscal year, and other basic filters.

- Full understanding of our requirements.
- The source of financial data is correctly identified.
- The formulas and structure used in the reports align with accounting requirements.

- Experience with Odoo 10 Community
- Good understanding of accounting principles and Odoo reporting structure
- Python, PostgreSQL
- Odoo QWeb/XML for custom report templates
- UI development for internal tools
- Comfort working on Odoo in a Linux (Ubuntu) VPS environment (e.g., DigitalOcean)

Familiarity with UAE accounting standards, VAT rules, and Corporate Tax requirements is a plus, as this exercise is part of aligning our Odoo system with FTAA audit readiness, especially for corporate tax compliance.


5.0 Deliverables:
- Updated ledger groupings
- Three functional reports with:
- user-friendly UI

Deployment through staging to production

- Clear communication in English
